description:

Bei uns schreibt niemand mehr Tickets ab. Unser eigener Agent-Harness baut aus Specs Software, lässt Agenten sich gegenseitig reviewen und deployt automatisiert. Software-Fabrik & Harness

Architektur & Sparring

  • Architektur verantworten: Nest.js-APIs, Web-App, native Apps (Kotlin/Swift), PostgreSQL

Qualifikation

Must-Have

  • Du hast schon Software mit Agenten gebaut, nicht nur mit Autocomplete: eigener Harness, Specs, Agenten-Review, automatisiertes Deployment. Du kannst uns zeigen, was davon ohne dich weiterläuft.

Nice-to-Have

  • Kotlin oder Swift, Monorepo-Setups, AWS Bedrock
  • Erfahrung, ein kleines Team fachlich zu führen
  • Erfahrung in B2B-SaaS, Handwerk oder Bau

Benefits

  • Startup mit echtem Impact: Kleines Team, viel Verantwortung und KI als kraftvoller Hebel. Du entscheidest mit, wie unsere Software entsteht.

title: Personalreferent (m/w/d) in Teilzeit (20 Stunden/Woche)

Als neues Teammitglied stehen Sie bei uns an erster Stelle. Freuen Sie sich auf ein kollegiales Arbeitsumfeld, kurze Entscheidungswege und eine Aufgabe, in der Verlässlichkeit, Eigenverantwortung und Zusammenarbeit großgeschrieben werden. Werden Sie als Personalreferent (m/w/d) in Teilzeit am Standort Ratingen Teil der Lintorfer Eisengießerei GmbH und gestalten Sie unsere Personalarbeit praxisnah und zukunftsorientiert mit.

  • Ganzheitliche Betreuung und Beratung der Mitarbeitenden und Führungskräfte in personalwirtschaftlichen, arbeitsrechtlichen und tariflichen Fragestellungen

title: IT Helpdesk Engineer
description:
Superhuman team members in this role must be based in Berlin, and they must be able to collaborate in person five days a week.

 

The Opportunity

To achieve our ambitious goals, we're looking for an IT Helpdesk Engineer to join our team in Berlin to ensure smooth IT operations, support events and large meetings. This role requires a generalist with exposure across IT domains (IAM, MDM, AV, SaaS administration, etc.). We’re looking for tech-savvy individual with excellent communication skills, technical skills, and a high degree of ownership to be available in hub to deliver a seamless user experience.

Superhuman's engineers and researchers have the freedom to innovate and uncover breakthroughs—and, in turn, influence our product roadmap. The complexity of our technical challenges is growing rapidly as we scale our interfaces, algorithms, and infrastructure.

As an IT Helpdesk Engineer, you will collaborate with the global team to continuously improve the service delivery of the frontline IT team. Your responsibilities include providing support to our team members in our Berlin hub, collaborating with the onsite teams for AV and event support and general support requests. Your participation in the planning and design of the IT service will help ensure a consistent and seamless experience for all of our hubs.

In this role, you will:

  • Provide first-level IT support to team members, including troubleshooting hardware and software issues, resolving network connectivity problems, and assisting with AV equipment setup and configuration

  • Provide a single point of contact for executives based in the Berlin hub

  • Coordinate with other team members to support events and large meetings, coordinating additional resources as necessary

  • Maintain and troubleshoot IT assets in our office, including computers, laptops, printers, and AV equipment

  • Provide hardware and software to existing team members and new hires

  • Support ZOOM rooms in person and remotely

  • Maintain accurate IT and AV support requests, resolutions, and equipment inventory records

  • Stay up-to-date with the newest IT trends and technologies to recommend improvements and enhancements

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field

  • Driven to provide outstanding customer service and has excellent communication skills

  • Experience in supporting executives and high profile team members

  • Experience in IT support, A/V equipment management, and event coordination

  • Strong knowledge of macOS and Windows operating systems

  • Excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving skills

  • Excited to work independently and as part of an international team

  • Detail-oriented and organized with strong documentation skills

  • Has a demonstrated ability to work independently with minimal guidance, proactively manages tasks and priorities across multiple projects, analyzes and executes work efficiently, collaborates effectively with cross-functional teams, and thrives in fast-paced, results-driven environments.

  • Embodies our EAGER values—is ethical, adaptable, gritty, empathetic, and remarkable.

  • Is inspired by our MOVE principles: move fast and learn faster; obsess about creating customer value; value impact over activity; and embrace healthy disagreement rooted in trust.

  • JAMF Certification, Okta Certification and Windows Certifications are a plus.

Support for you, professionally and personally

  • Professional Growth: We believe that autonomy and trust are key to empowering our team members to do their best, most innovative work in a way that aligns with their interests, talents, and well-being

  • A connected team: Superhuman builds a product that helps people connect, and we apply this mindset to our own team. We also celebrate our colleagues and accomplishments with global, local, and team-specific programs.

  • Comprehensive benefits for candidates based in Germany: Superhuman offers all team members competitive pay along with a benefits package encompassing life care (including mental health care and risk benefits) and ample and defined time off. We also offer support to set up a home office, wellness and pet care stipends, learning and development opportunities, and more.

  • Relocation Support: Superhuman provides relocation support to make your move to Berlin seamless. Our package includes visa assistance, destination services to help you and your family settle in comfortably, and a relocation bonus to cover additional expenses, such as temporary housing.

About Docker

Docker has been one of the most loved brands in developer tooling, trusted by more than 20 million monthly users and over 20 billion container image pulls. From solo founders to the world's largest companies, developers rely on Docker to build, share, and run their applications across our suite of products including Docker Desktop, Docker Hub, and Docker Scout.

We are a globally distributed, remote-first team building the tools that define how software gets built and delivered. _______________________________________________________________________

As a Senior Security Engineer, Offensive Security, you'll help drive offensive security at Docker, putting our products, platforms, and cloud infrastructure under realistic adversarial testing to surface and drive out attack paths before real adversaries find them. You'll partner with engineering, product, and leadership to turn findings into durable fixes and to shape how security is designed into every Docker product.

You'll apply your expertise in penetration testing, threat modeling, and exploit development to find and eliminate risks across Docker products and infrastructure. Working across cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, Azure), containerized environments, and AI/ML products, you'll implement proactive security solutions that scale with Docker's growth.

This role offers the opportunity to help improve security programs at a company whose products are trusted by millions of developers worldwide. You'll work in a fast-paced, technically challenging environment where your security expertise directly impacts both Docker's platform and the broader container ecosystem.

Responsibilities:

  • Contribute to security initiatives that align with business goals, helping ensure security is a core component of our products and infrastructure

  • Support and help implement key security programs such as automated security design reviews, and vulnerability management

  • Build deep knowledge of software security and architecture, and act as a go-to resource for engineering teams

  • Partner with engineering to design and implement security architecture and controls across Docker products and platforms

  • Plan, scope, and execute penetration tests and red-team / adversary-emulation engagements against Docker's products and services

  • Develop proof-of-concept exploits and produce clear, risk-rated findings with actionable remediation guidance, then retest fixes to confirm closure

  • Build and maintain offensive security tooling and automation to expand testing coverage and repeatability

  • Perform security reviews and threat modeling (design, architecture, and code) across Docker products and services, including emerging AI products, and write automated security tests and exploits

  • Serve on rotating on-call schedule to respond to security events, investigate threats, and coordinate remediation efforts

  • Educate and collaborate with cross-functional teams (e.g., engineering, product) to promote security practices

  • Participate in Security Incident response

Qualifications

  • Have 3+ years in security engineering, including hands-on offensive security and penetration testing across applications and infrastructure

  • Possess 2+ years of hands-on development experience in Python or Golang

  • Demonstrate deep expertise in authentication, authorization, including technologies like OAuth, cryptography applications and Zero Trust principles.

  • Have strong hands-on experience with securing cloud ecosystems (e.g. AWS, GCP, Azure)

  • Have hands-on penetration testing experience across SaaS web applications and APIs., including manual exploitation beyond automated scanners

  • Are proficient with offensive tooling and techniques such as. Burp Suite, and OWASP frameworks

  • Can write security tests and develop exploits and proof-of-concepts that find real vulnerabilities in a product

  • Understand AI/ML security risks and mitigations, including prompt injection, data poisoning, model extraction, and adversarial attacks

  • Have practical experience using LLMs and agentic tooling to automate vulnerability discovery, reconnaissance, and pentesting workflows

  • Have a track record of building security programs and automations from scratch, applying risk-based prioritization

  • Have experience performing security reviews and building or improving security review automation

  • Have excellent communication skills, allowing you to explain complex security concepts clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders

  • Understand industry standards, and actively keep up with emerging security technologies and models

  • Are a team player who drives security change via collaboration and cross-functional partnerships

  • Hold offensive security certifications such as OSCP, OSWE, OSEP, GXPN, GPEN, or CRTO

  • Have published CVEs, original security research, or conference talks

Bonus if you:

  • Have experience with container escape, Kubernetes attack paths, or cloud red teaming

  • Have experience testing AI/ML systems for issues like prompt injection, model extraction, and data poisoning

  • Meet with security team and key partners across engineering

  • Gain access to team owned systems, and internal documentation

  • Complete security awareness training and compliance onboarding

  • Review application architecture, tech stack and data flow

  • Review risk registry and annual roadmap

  • Familiarize oneself with team workflows and processes

  • Shadow a fellow security engineer during their on-call/secops rotations

First 90 days:

  • Scope and execute your first penetration test against a Docker product or service

Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. About the role:

As a Backend Senior Software Engineer on the Data Layer team, you'll help build and evolve the storage and query layer that keeps Camunda 8's process data fast, accurate, and available at scale. Spanning both relational databases and Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, the data layer and its data pipelines power everything from process monitoring to the new agent-driven automation capabilities we're rolling out.

As part of the Data Layer team, you will work on both technically challenging and rewarding projects, such as reshaping how we store and retain process data, streaming data to external systems, and evolving our secondary storage systems to perform at ever greater scale.

At Camunda, we approach engineering in a holistic manner. As such, you will form strong partnerships with product management, design, QA, and support, and work with your peers to not only deliver but directly influence how our data layer evolves to meet our customers' needs.

Curious about the kind of challenges you'll work on at Camunda? Watch this quick 30-minute talk from our engineers to learn more about the new Camunda Exporter and how we’re solving complex problems at scale

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Design, build, and maintain backend services for the data layer that stores and serves Camunda 8's process data, spanning relational databases and Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, with an eye toward correctness, performance, and scale.

  • Own the end-to-end delivery of engineering initiatives, working with Product Management and colleagues across the business to break down requirements into concrete solution designs, driving projects to timely and high-quality delivery.

  • Help evolve how we process, retain, and expose process data, so customers can work with their data the way they need to.

  • Invest in making our secondary storage systems more performant and scalable as usage grows, and build tooling that makes it easier to understand, troubleshoot, and safely operate the data layer in production.

  • Participate in L3 support and on-call rotations, partnering with Support and SRE to investigate data layer production issues, and feeding what you learn back into the product. 

What You Bring:

  • Ability and/or willingness to use our product

  •  At least 7 years of experience as a backend engineer, with a strong focus on backend systems and production data stores

  • Deep experience with both Relational Databases (ideally PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, or MSSQL), and Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, with a practical understanding of query performance, indexing, and data modeling trade-offs

  • Proven experience leading medium-to-large engineering initiatives (3+ months) end-to-end — solution design, project planning, coordinating across teams, and driving predictable delivery.

  • Comfortable investigating slow queries, execution plans, and index usage to root-cause data-related production issues.

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills in a remote-first environment: you translate requirements into actionable technical work with Product, and give and receive clear, direct feedback in code review.

  • Experience building workflow automation or process orchestration software.

  • Experience working with both relational databases and Elasticsearch/OpenSearch.

  • Experience building or maintaining CI pipelines.

  • Understanding of database migration tooling (e.g. Liquibase, Flyway) and schema evolution in a live system.

title: Marketing Lead
description:
Who We Are:
At Omaze, we give our community in the UK and Germany the chance to win luxury homes and other life-changing prizes — all while raising money for the causes they love.

Thanks to our Omaze Community, we’ve raised over £150 million for UK charities in just five years. That’s millions helping organisations like Age UK, the RSPCA, British Heart Foundation and Great Ormond Street Hospital Charity deliver life-saving work.

And the best part? We’re only just getting started. Omaze is building a business and culture committed to growth and creating significant social impact on a global scale.

🔑 About The Job

Having launched the Million Pound House Draw in 2020, one of the UK’s fastest ever growing products that to date has raised over £150M for charity, Omaze is preparing to build and launch our next big thing. Designed to take our playbook of dream property prizes to new audiences we are seeking a talented and hungry marketeer to help us make it all happen.

Alongside the General Manager you will shape the new proposition and the strategy to bring it to a new audience — defining that audience, positioning the brand and running the creative platform, launching the proposition, and creating a sustainable engine for both brand and commercial growth.

This is a rare opportunity to take something from zero to one and then build the operating rhythm that allows it to grow. You'll start by developing a deep understanding of the customer, defining our positioning and go-to-market strategy, and leading the launch. From there, you'll own the marketing approach for a regular cadence of new campaigns, using customer insight, brand signals and performance data to improve the proposition each time.

You won't have a large dedicated marketing team around you. Instead, you'll need to roll your sleeves up and get it all done, with support from specialists inside and outside of Omaze — including Creative, Performance Marketing, CRM, Brand, PR, Analytics and Product — bringing it all together, delivering a clear strategy and executing brilliantly.

This role is ideal for someone who combines strong consumer marketing instincts, brand and creative judgement, commercial thinking and hands-on execution.

🔧 What You’ll Be Doing

Build the go-to-market strategy

  • Develop the end-to-end go-to-market strategy for a new Omaze proposition, from initial customer understanding through launch and scale.

  • Define our priority audiences, their motivations and barriers, and the occasions that will drive participation.

  • Define what this new product should stand for in customers' minds, how it should differentiate itself and how it should relate to the wider Omaze brand and product set.

  • Develop the brand positioning, messaging architecture and creative platform that can build recognition, relevance and desire over time.

  • Determine how the new proposition should relate to the broader Omaze brand and existing product portfolio - including driving incrementality

  • Partner with Product, Commercial, Analytics and Research teams to shape decisions around the customer experience, offer and proposition.

  • Build a clear acquisition and retention strategy, identifying the channels, messages and customer journeys most likely to drive sustainable growth.

  • Translate strategy into measurable objectives, combining brand and commercial KPIs.

Lead every campaign

  • Own the marketing strategy and integrated campaign plan for each new property prize launch.

  • Turn each new campaign into a compelling customer story with a clear audience, insight, proposition and creative brief.

  • Ensure every individual property campaign strengthens the brand as well as delivering its immediate commercial objectives.

  • Set a high creative bar and work closely with Creative teams to develop work that is distinctive, emotionally compelling and capable of building the brand over time.

  • Lead the cross-functional marketing squad responsible for bringing campaigns to market.

  • Partner with Creative, Performance Marketing, CRM, PR, Social and other teams to deliver against the strategy.

  • Ensure every customer touchpoint works together as one coherent campaign, from first impression through conversion and repeat participation.

  • Make clear prioritisation and investment recommendations based on expected commercial impact.

Build the playbook

  • Establish the processes, templates, measurement framework and operating cadence required to run campaigns repeatedly and efficiently.

  • Track and develop our understanding of brand health alongside commercial performance, using measures such as awareness, consideration and customer perceptions where appropriate.

  • Design and prioritise tests across audiences, propositions, messaging, creative, channels and customer journeys.

  • Know when to experiment and optimise, and when consistency and creative conviction are more important than reacting to short-term campaign data.

  • Build a strong understanding of what drives performance by customer segment and campaign type.

  • Turn learnings from each campaign into improvements for the next, creating a compounding growth loop rather than starting from scratch each time.

  • Bring customer insight and market intelligence back into the wider business to help shape the future product roadmap.

🤩 About You

We're less interested in a particular industry background than in finding someone who has the right attitude and has shown success at building consumer brands and growing new consumer propositions.

You'll probably have:

  • Significant experience in consumer marketing, brand, growth or integrated marketing roles.

  • Experience taking a new proposition, product or category from early-stage concept through launch and growth.

  • Strong customer and commercial instincts: you can move comfortably between qualitative customer insight, proposition development and quantitative performance data.

  • A strong understanding of how brand building and customer acquisition work together to create sustainable growth.

  • Experience developing positioning, messaging, customer segmentation and integrated brand and marketing strategies.

  • Strong experimentation instincts and experience using data to improve marketing performance over time, without becoming overly dependent on short-term performance signals..

  • The ability to lead complex cross-functional work without needing direct reporting lines.

  • Excellent briefing and communication skills, particularly with creative and channel specialists.

  • Comfort operating in ambiguity and building processes where none yet exist.

  • The judgement to know when something needs deep analysis and when it simply needs to get done.

🙌 What’s In It For You

  • Generous stock options scheme

  • 25 days annual leave PLUS Bank Holidays

  • Private medical and dental insurance

  • 9% employer pension contributions, when you contribute at least 2%

  • A generous personal learning and development budget each year to use on training courses, conferences and professional memberships

  • Enhanced family leave policies

  • Life assurance of 4x your salary

DEI Statement

We actively seek out diversity of thought and experience to drive innovation. We welcome all backgrounds, identities, and perspectives and work hard to ensure that every Omaze employee can bring their authentic self to work at all times.

Checkout.com and the CEO Office

Checkout.com is building the future of payments.

Our global, multi-product payments network helps businesses move money, improve acceptance, manage fraud and turn payments into a competitive advantage. Headquartered in London, with offices around the world, Checkout.com is trusted by leading brands including eBay, DocuSign, Vinted, Uber, Klarna, Wise, Pinterest, Grab and Sony.

We are scaling a high-impact Strategy & Operations team within the CEO Office to strengthen product delivery and execution across the business.

Working alongside Product, Engineering and other functions, you will lead complex strategic and operational initiatives, align stakeholders, manage dependencies, resolve blockers and drive delivery from planning through launch. This is a business execution and operating leadership role—not primarily a consulting or process-improvement role.

You will use data and first-principles thinking to identify root causes, design practical solutions and build scalable operating mechanisms. The role offers high visibility with the CEO and executive team, with opportunities to grow into broader responsibilities across Product, Technology and the wider organisation.

How you’ll make an impact

  • Drive strategic initiatives: Lead major cross-functional projects, create alignment, clarify ownership, manage risks and make sure initiatives launch effectively.

  • Build scalable operating mechanisms: Develop practical standards and processes for planning, testing, launch readiness, governance, reporting and cross-functional decision-making.

  • Improve measurable business outcomes: Take ownership of specific processes or metrics where there is a clear opportunity to improve speed, quality or scalability.

Success means owning and delivering meaningful business projects—not simply diagnosing problems or redesigning processes in isolation. You will build trust with your Product team or pillar, take ownership of strategic initiatives and turn ambiguous priorities into clear, measurable plans that drive delivery through launch.

What we’re looking for: Background and core competencies

You may come from strategy consulting, investment banking, product, technology, operations, professional services or a high-growth company. We’re looking for multiple years of experience in influential, ideally cross-functional roles in fast-paced, high-performance environments, with evidence of problem-solving, ownership and impact rather than a particular career path.   • Cross-functional delivery: Experience leading high-priority projects end to end, from framing the problem and aligning stakeholders to implementing solutions and delivering measurable outcomes.

  • Data-driven decision-making: Ability to identify the right metrics, own data collection and analysis, and use dashboards or other tools to make progress, bottlenecks and performance visible.

  • Building and automation: Willingness to understand processes at ground level, then create or materially improve systems, workflows and operating capabilities from 0 to 1.

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

  • Step 4 → $1T/yr by end of 2035: With one line of code and zero human time, you can use AIOS to treat any patient globally with any medication.

In so doing, we'll become the world's first trillion-dollar healthcare company.

We're a young, founder-led company. This is still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

Being a Dispenser at Bolt Pharmacy

We are building a world-class team.

As a Dispenser at Bolt Pharmacy (part of AIOS), your fundamental role is to turn prescriptions into treatment patients can count on - safely, accurately and at pace.

You'll be at the heart of our dispensing operation, selecting, labelling and securely packing medicines for patients across the UK. You'll take ownership of your work within your qualified scope, follow dispensing procedures precisely and escalate clinical questions to our pharmacists. Every prescription has a person behind it.

You'll keep quality high as volumes grow. From protecting the cold chain and monitoring storage temperatures to managing stock and checking deliveries, you'll help keep medicines safe and orders moving. You'll report errors and near misses promptly, so we learn quickly and keep improving.

Working alongside pharmacists, fellow dispensers and our stock and customer service teams, you'll help resolve issues before they delay treatment. You'll also support trainee dispensers and spot practical ways to make Bolt Pharmacy's operation more efficient. Your experience will help raise the standard of the whole team.

Great performance means consistently processing 30+ orders per hour while maintaining over 99.5% dispensing accuracy, zero critical errors and full compliance with our procedures. Patients receive the right treatment, colleagues trust your work and we can serve more people with confidence.

This is a full-time, on-site role at Bolt Pharmacy in Blackburn, UK, working standard business hours with possible shift patterns.

You'll report directly to our Shift Lead and work closely with our Site Operations Lead, Michal Binkowski.

You'll work most closely with Bolt Pharmacy's pharmacists, qualified and trainee dispensers, Stock Control and Customer Service, combining dispensing oversight, shared workloads and patient support.

Key responsibilities

  • Get every prescription right: Select, label and prepare medicines accurately within your qualified scope, following SOPs and escalating clinical queries to pharmacists.

  • Keep treatment moving: Process and securely pack 30+ orders per hour while maintaining accuracy, safety and compliance.

  • Protect every medicine: Maintain cold-chain controls, monitor fridge and room temperatures, and escalate storage deviations immediately.

  • Take ownership of stock: Check incoming deliveries, maintain correct storage and rotation, and support stock takes so medicines are available when needed.

  • Make quality everyone's business: Record errors, near misses and incidents promptly, keep workstations clean and compliant, follow hygiene and PPE procedures, and suggest practical improvements.

  • Raise the team's standard: Guide trainee dispensers, support colleagues and work with Customer Service to resolve patient queries and order updates.

Need to have

  • Dispensing qualification: You hold a valid Buttercups certification or equivalent dispensing qualification.

  • Experience at pace: You've worked in high-volume dispensing and can consistently meet a target of 30+ orders per hour without compromising safety.

  • Attention to detail: You bring exceptional accuracy to medicine selection, labelling and prescription preparation.

  • Ownership within your scope: You organise your workload independently, follow SOPs precisely and know when to involve a pharmacist.

  • Professionalism: You're reliable, punctual and committed to patient safety and regulatory compliance.

Nice to have

  • Qualified experience: You've spent at least a year working as a qualified dispenser.

  • Online pharmacy: You understand the demands of dispensing and dispatching treatment to patients remotely.

  • Mentoring: You've trained or supported junior colleagues and can explain procedures clearly.

  • Stock management: You bring experience in inventory control, stock rotation and keeping a busy dispensary supplied.

  • Patient support: You've handled healthcare queries with care, clarity and professionalism.

  • Pharmacy standards: You're familiar with GPhC requirements and how they translate into everyday practice.

Our cultural standards

We aim to make this your life's work. This should be the most challenging, most rewarding role of your life. Accordingly, these are the core cultural standards to which we hold ourselves & our team-members:

  1. Belief in the mission: We will have served 100 million patients by the end of 2035 and we transform the life of most patients who join. We have a lot of work to do. We are obsessed with our patients and are dedicated to the mission.

  2. Unwavering integrity: We are at the frontier, so we often live in ambiguity with no trodden path. When we can't look to others for guidance, we must maintain impeccable ethics and unwavering integrity.

  3. Only the paranoid survive: Bad sh*t is coming. By joining us, you're choosing to sail straight towards the storms with unhesitating conviction. However much we've already done, however far we've already come — it's still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

  4. If we're average we fail: We are only interested in "insanely great", a focus on the quality of our execution that in everyday life would be considered pathological. We have a dedication to excellence and reject incompetence.

  5. Commitment to candor: That which can be destroyed by the truth should be. You get full transparency from the company and the company expects full transparency from you. We never say anything about someone that we wouldn't say to them directly. We give feedback with love and do not need to protect people from fleeting physical sensations.

  6. A maniacal sense of urgency: We execute at an intensity that most people think is impossible. Speed is critical and we need things done yesterday. We all work very hard and in such a competitive world there really is no other way to win.

  7. Enduring frugality: We are frugal. We hate being wasteful and we are anti-luxury. A culture of cheapness keeps us young. We spend our cash wisely & carefully — in a way that would make our grandmas proud.

  8. Bulldozing barriers: The world is malleable and we shape it. We truly believe this and act accordingly. We are relentlessly resourceful and are at the mercy of no-one but ourselves. You'll be shocked how capable you are and how much you can achieve.

Dans le cadre du développement de nos activités, nous recherchons un·e Juriste Senior - DPO & Conformité IA.

Rattaché·e à la Directrice Juridique Groupe, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans le déploiement et l'animation du dispositif de conformité du groupe PulluP. En autonomie, vous accompagnerez de manière opérationnelle l’ensemble de nos métiers et filiales sur les enjeux cruciaux liés à la protection des données personnelles et à l'encadrement de l'Intelligence Artificielle.

Au sein de la Direction Juridique, vous pourrez également être amené(e) à prêter main-forte sur d'autres thématiques transverses relatives à la conformité globale du Groupe.

  • Élaborer un reporting régulier et précis sur l'état de la conformité de votre périmètre pour la direction du Groupe PulluP.

  • Être l’interlocuteur des autres autorités de contrôle concernées (CNIL, DGCCRF, ARCOM, ANSSI, etc.).

  • Assurer une veille réglementaire et jurisprudentielle proactive (Data & IA) pour anticiper les impacts sur les activités du groupe.

2) Conformité RGPD & Opérationnel

3) Déploiement & Sécurisation de l'IA (AI Act)

  • Mettre en œuvre et documenter les processus de conformité IA (contrôles, traçabilité) pour garantir le respect de l'AI Act et des réglementations applicables.

  • Conseiller les équipes opérationnelles et négocier les clauses contractuelles relatives à la Data et à l'IA avec nos fournisseurs et partenaires.

  • Concevoir et animer des actions de sensibilisation et de formation à destination des différentes directions du groupe.


Ce que l’on attend de vous :

  • Vous maîtrisez des enjeux liés au traitement des données des mineurs et aux mécanismes de vérification d'âge.

title: Tech Lead Marketplace Experience (m/w/d)
description:
Über die Position

Gestalte mit uns die digitale Infrastruktur des europäischen Gartenbaus

Connected Growers entwickelt June  - die Plattform, über die Erzeuger, B2B Käufer und Vermarkter effizient zusammenarbeiten. Wir ersetzen fragmentierte Prozesse durch moderne Software und schaffen eine gemeinsame digitale Infrastruktur für eine ganze Branche.

Dafür suchen wir Verstärkung als Tech Lead Marketplace Experience (m/w/d), um nicht nur Software zu entwickeln, sondern ein Team aufzubauen, technische Verantwortung zu übernehmen und gemeinsam mit dem Produkt-Team die Zukunft unserer Plattform zu gestalten.

Deine Rolle bei June

Als Tech Lead Grower Marketplace Experience (m/w/d) verantwortest du die technische Entwicklung unseres Marketplace und der dazugehörigen Services. Du berichtest direkt an unsere CTO Anna.

Du baust einen neuen Engineering Squad von Grund auf auf und übernimmst die technische und fachliche Verantwortung für einen der kommerziell wichtigsten Bereiche von June. Es geht nicht nur darum, gute Software zu bauen: Du setzt technische Richtung, triffst Entscheidungen unter Unsicherheit, entwickelst Menschen, und prägst die Kultur deines Squads. Du sorgst gemeinsam mit dem Produkt-Team dafür, dass wir Funktionen entwickeln, die für unsere Kunden messbaren Mehrwert schaffen.

Wir geben dir den Kontext und den Freiraum, den du brauchst, um deinen Bereich eigenständig zu führen. Im Gegenzug erwarten wir, dass du Verantwortung übernimmst, Entscheidungen triffst und auch für ihre Konsequenzen einstehst – in einem dynamischen Umfeld, in dem sich Prioritäten verändern und Informationen nicht immer vollständig vorliegen.

Du bist kein klassischer People Manager. Du führst über technische Tiefe, Klarheit, Entscheidungen und Vertrauen. Du bleibst hands-on im Code, ohne zum technischen Bottleneck zu werden, triffst Architekturentscheidungen und unterstützt dein Team dabei, gemeinsam hochwertige Software zu entwickeln.

Unser Marketplace basiert auf dem Spryker Commerce OS. Du entwickelst ein klares Verständnis dafür, wann wir innerhalb der Spryker-Konventionen arbeiten, wann wir erweitern und wann eine individuelle Lösung sinnvoll ist. Dabei behältst du immer die langfristige Wartbarkeit und Erweiterbarkeit unserer Plattform im Blick.


Anforderungen

Was du mitbringst

  • Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung als Tech Lead oder Senior Engineer in Web- und E-Commerce-Anwendungen sowie fundierte praktische Erfahrung mit PHP und Spryker Commerce OS und weißt, wann du innerhalb der Spryker-Konventionen arbeitest, erweiterst oder bewusst davon abweichst.

  • Du bringst Erfahrung mit API- bzw. Spec-first-Entwicklung sowie mit AWS-Cloud-Infrastrukturen, modernen Deployment-Prozessen und Monitoring mit.

  • Du hast bereits Erfahrung im Teamaufbau und weißt, worauf es ankommt.

  • Du hast Verständnis, Interesse und Lust an Produktentwicklung (Software) und Teamentwicklung (Menschen).

  • Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich, kommunizierst klar, hast hohe Qualitätsansprüche und sprichst fließend Deutsch sowie sehr gutes Englisch.

Das wäre ein Plus

  • Gute Kenntnisse in TypeScript.

  • Erfahrung mit ERP-, Warehouse- oder Commerce-Systemen.

  • Erfahrung mit komplexen Order-, Pricing- oder Inventory/Catalogue-Prozessen.

  • Erfahrung in einem Startup oder schnell wachsenden Technologieunternehmen.


Aufgabenbereich

Was du bei uns bewegst

  • Du verantwortest Architektur, technische Qualität und Weiterentwicklung des Marketplace und seiner Services.

  • Du baust dein Squad auf, entwickelst deine Teammitglieder weiter und schaffst eine Kultur aus Ownership, Pragmatismus und kontinuierlichem Lernen.

  • Du entwickelst eine klare technische Strategie für den Produktbereich Marketplace Experience und triffst bewusste Entscheidungen darüber, wie wir Spryker einsetzen und erweitern.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit dem Produkt-Team zusammen und übersetzt die Bedürfnisse unserer Käufer und Verkäufer in nachhaltige technische Lösungen..

  • Du sorgst dafür, dass dein Team Software kontinuierlich, sicher und zuverlässig ausliefert – von der technischen Spezifikation und Architektur über API-Design und Entwicklung bis hin zu Betrieb, Incident Management und kontinuierlicher Verbesserung.

  • Du übernimmst Verantwortung für Performance, Stabilität, Security und Compliance und stellst sicher, dass technische Risiken früh erkannt, bewertet und bewusst adressiert werden.

  • Du nutzt AI selbstverständlich im Engineering-Alltag und hilfst deinem Team dabei, AI sinnvoll und verantwortungsvoll für Entwicklung, Testing, Dokumentation und Code Reviews einzusetzen.

So arbeiten wir

Unsere Teams verantworten ihren Produktbereich komplett: Architektur, API-Design, Entwicklung, Betrieb, Incidents, Security, Compliance. Die kommerziellen KPIs gehören dazu.

Wir reden mit Kunden, fahren zu ihnen raus, testen unsere Lösungen dort im Betrieb. Verantwortung endet nicht am Merge-Button.


Die Perspektive

Was dich erwartet

  • Du baust etwas auf, statt ein bestehendes Team zu verwalten.

  • Du bekommst einen klar abgegrenzten Verantwortungsbereich und die Freiheit, ihn zu gestalten.

  • Du arbeitest direkt mit CTO und Product Manager und kannst technische, produktbezogene, kulturprägende und kommerzielle Entscheidungen tatsächlich beeinflussen.

  • Du siehst die Konsequenzen deiner Entscheidungen unmittelbar – im Produkt, im Team und im Geschäft.

  • Hybrides Arbeiten in unserem Büro in Köln sowie regelmäßige Besuche bei Kund*innen, Gärtner*innen und Partner*innen vor Ort



Diese Stellenbeschreibung ist bewusst meinungsstark und setzt hohe Standards. Wir suchen nicht den perfekten Lebenslauf, sondern Menschen, die bei Connected Growers glücklich werden. Wenn du nicht alle formalen Kriterien erfüllst, dich aber in der Art, wie wir arbeiten und führen, wiedererkennst, freuen wir uns trotzdem über deine Bewerbung. Was dir an einzelnen Punkten noch fehlt, können wir gemeinsam entwickeln – entscheidend ist, dass du das Mindset und die Bereitschaft mitbringst, in diese Rolle hineinzuwachsen.

Hinweis: Die Stelle wird zunächst über BridgeMaker besetzt und im weiteren Verlauf zu Connected Growers überführt.

Contexte :

Le stage à pourvoir s’inscrit dans le cadre du projet européen Best-Crop impliquant 18 partenaires à l’échelle européenne : https://www.bestcrop.eu/ dont le but est de contribuer à développer l’économie circulaire en offrant de nouvelles variétés d’orge à rendement amélioré (article de perspective – projet Best-Crop). ). L’un des volets du projet consiste à fournir des pailles d’orge de composition et/ou structure optimisées pour différentes applications, dont, entre autres, le secteur de la construction (fabrication de panneaux de particules et de biocomposites).

Le travail contribuera également à compléter la large base de données sur les panneaux à renforts lignocellulosiques développés au laboratoire.

title: TECH LEAD IA H/F
description:
Le rôle

Équiper des équipes de LLM et de coding agents prend un après-midi. Les faire travailler en AI-Native SDLC, c'est-à-dire concevoir et livrer du logiciel avec des agents dans la boucle plutôt qu'à côté, demande de faire évoluer tout l'environnement autour : architecture, gestion du contexte, harness (la couche système qui donne à un agent ses outils, ses permissions et son contexte d'exécution), developer platforms, intégration au SI, infrastructure, sécurité, observabilité, évaluation.

Comme Tech Lead, tu aides nos clients à comprendre ces transformations, tu arbitres les décisions d'architecture qui en découlent et tu mets en place les capacités qui leur manquent. Tu conçois, tu conseilles, et tu descends dans le code quand il faut confronter une décision au réel.

Pourquoi on ouvre ce poste

Nos clients ont dépassé le stade du POC. Leur question porte maintenant sur l'intégration des agents au SI et au cycle de delivery, et sur ce qui doit être mutualisé dans une plateforme plutôt que laissé à chaque équipe. Ce sont des questions d'architecture, et on n'a personne dont c'est le métier à plein temps.


Tes missions 🎯

•    comprendre le contexte Product, business et technologique du client, son SI et son environnement de delivery

•    identifier ce que l'IA change et les capacités technologiques qui manquent pour y répondre

•    concevoir les architectures et arbitrer les choix structurants : build ou buy, plateforme ou équipe, standardisation ou autonomie, besoin immédiat ou capacité durable

•    prototyper ou implémenter certains composants quand une décision d'architecture a besoin d'être éprouvée

•    accompagner les équipes client et faire monter les équipes Thiga en compétence

•    intervenir en avant-vente comme garant technique, challenger les demandes et aider le client à transformer un problème flou en décision


Deux exemples de ce que ça donne concrètement 👀

Passer à l'échelle avec les coding agents

Le cas du début. Tu analyses l'existant, tu identifies les capacités manquantes et tu conçois l'architecture qui permet aux équipes et aux agents de travailler ensemble de façon observable et sécurisée. Le vrai sujet est souvent le knowledge : reconstruire un contexte exploitable à partir de repos, de docs et de conventions que personne n'a maintenus depuis trois ans.

Décider ce qui se mutualise

Cinq équipes expérimentent chacune avec leurs propres modèles, agents et outils. Tu aides le client à trancher ce qui remonte dans une plateforme, ce qui reste décentralisé et dans quel ordre y aller. La réponse est rarement la grande plateforme IA. C'est plus souvent trois capacités bien choisies qui débloquent tout le monde.


Avec qui tu travailles 🤝

  • Chez nos clients : CTO, responsables Engineering, architectes, Platform Engineers, développeurs, équipes sécurité et Product. Tu dois pouvoir passer d'une discussion d'architecture très technique à une décision avec un dirigeant dans la même journée.

  •  

    Chez Thiga : nos Product Builders, Product Engineers et consultants Product. Ton rôle est de construire les enablers technologiques qui leur permettent de tirer parti de l'IA sur leurs missions, et de les faire progresser.


    • Ton profil 🚀

    Une culture Tech large

    Tu es d'abord un bon technologue. Tu comprends assez bien les systèmes logiciels modernes pour raisonner sur une architecture entière : software architecture, systèmes distribués, APIs, données, cloud, infrastructure, sécurité, IAM, CI/CD, developer platforms, observabilité. On cherche quelqu'un capable de repérer ce qui est structurant, de comprendre les interactions entre les couches et d'aller en profondeur quand le problème l'exige, plutôt qu'un spécialiste de chacune de ces disciplines. Tu as assez de kilomètres au compteur, souvent une dizaine d'années, pour avoir vu des architectures évoluer, atteindre leurs limites et parfois échouer.

    Une vraie profondeur IA

    Tu comprends les systèmes construits avec des LLM et des agents, ce qu'ils permettent et où ils coincent. Context engineering, retrieval, tool use, systèmes agentiques, evals, sécurité, observabilité : tu sais raisonner sur les propriétés architecturales que ces systèmes introduisent et sur ce qu'elles impliquent pour le reste du SI.

    Du jugement, et des mains

    Tu raisonnes en trade-offs, tu prends position et tu expliques pourquoi une option est préférable dans un contexte donné, sans confondre architecture et accumulation de technologies. Et tu es resté assez hands-on pour ouvrir le code, manipuler des APIs, explorer une infra ou monter un prototype quand ça devient le moyen le plus rapide de savoir.

    Une culture Product et client

    Tu cherches à comprendre le problème, les utilisateurs, les contraintes de l'organisation et le résultat attendu avant de dessiner une solution. Tu sais challenger un client, poser plusieurs options avec leurs compromis, puis l'aider à décider.

    Apprécié

    Une expérience du conseil, des transformations Product & Engineering, des developer platforms ou des systèmes IA en production. Si tu écris, contribues à de l'open source ou parles en conférence, c'est un vrai plus.


    Pourquoi Thiga 👀

    Thiga vient du Product Management, ce qui change la manière d'aborder l'AI-Native SDLC. Cette transformation touche la technologie, le produit et la façon dont les équipes travaillent en même temps, donc on refuse de la traiter comme un simple sujet d'outillage ou de plateforme.

    Tu seras rattaché à la Tribe Tech & IA, qui réunit nos Product Builders, les consultants qui déploient l'AI-Native SDLC chez nos clients et les architectes qui en construisent les enablers. Notre ambition : mener de vraies transformations chez nos clients, construire un collectif d'experts qui partage réellement ce qu'il apprend, et faire reconnaître Thiga comme un acteur de référence sur le sujet.

    Il y a donc une vraie dimension intrapreneuriale, et la liberté qui va avec.


    Process de recrutement 🎢

    1.   Premier échange avec une Chargée de recrutement : ton parcours, ce que tu cherches, et une présentation précise de Thiga et du rôle.

    2.   Cas et soutenance : on t'envoie un cas une semaine avant. L'exercice ne consiste pas à retrouver notre architecture ou à réciter une stack, on veut voir comment tu abordes un problème complexe, comment tu explores les options, comment tu arbitres et comment tu défends une recommandation. On évalue quatre dimensions : profondeur Tech, profondeur IA, culture Product, posture de conseil.

    3.   Rencontre finale avec un.e Directeur.rice : approfondir ce qui doit l'être et valider l'envie de travailler ensemble, des deux côtés.

    Notre culture
     
    Chez Thiga, nous vivons selon des principes forts :
    Product first 
    Nous pensons produit dans sa globalité, de l'expérience utilisateur jusqu'à l'infrastructure.
    Hands-on or nothing 
    Notre approche est radicalement pratique. Nous croyons en la démonstration concrète plutôt qu'en la théorie.
    Market Maker by Design 
    Nous repoussons les limites et partageons ouvertement nos innovations.
    Knowledge Open Bar 
    Le savoir n'a de valeur que lorsqu'il est largement partagé. Nous diffusons librement nos apprentissages et nos outils.
     
    Thiga accueille toutes les personnes compétentes et passionnées et s'engage en faveur de la diversité culturelle, l'égalité de genre et l'emploi des travailleurs handicapés — au contraire nous considérons la diversité comme une grande richesse

title: CENTRALE LYON ENISE - Post doctorat - Modélisation et optimisation de la sphéroïdisation de poudres métalliques par plasma RF
description:
Le poste est basé à Centrale Lyon ENISE, sur le campus stéphanois, qui accueille plus de 1250 élèves et 160 personnels, dans un environnement exceptionnel aux portes du Pilat. Centrale Lyon ENISE forme des ingénieurs de spécialité Génie mécanique, Génie civil, Génie sensoriel sous statut étudiant (FISE) ou sous statut apprenti (FISA).

DESCRIPTIF

Contexte scientifique :

Dans le cadre d'un projet ANR consacré au traitement et à la fonctionnalisation de poudres métalliques par plasma radiofréquence, le laboratoire souhaite recruter un post-doc pour développer une approche couplant modélisation physique, expérimentation et optimisation des paramètres de procédé.

Le travail portera principalement sur la sphéroïdisation de poudres d'AlSi10Mg par plasma RF inductif, réalisée sur une torche TekSphero40 (40 kW). Le procédé vise à transformer des particules initialement irrégulières en particules sphériques adaptées notamment aux procédés de fabrication additive métallique.

Le projet s'intéresse à un problème scientifique fortement couplé. L'augmentation de l'énergie apportée aux particules favorise leur fusion et leur sphéroïdisation, mais peut simultanément accentuer l'évaporation du magnésium, la formation de nanoparticules et la coalescence des particules en vol. L'objectif est donc de rechercher un compromis optimal entre plusieurs critères de qualité de la poudre.

Verrous scientifiques :

La fabrication additive métallique par fusion laser sur lit de poudre (L-PBF) nécessite des poudres très sphériques, coulables et chimiquement homogènes. Le procédé de sphéroïdisation par plasma à couplage inductif radiofréquence (RF) est une voie industrielle intéressante pour répondre à ces besoins. Dans ce procédé, la poudre traverse un plasma d'argon à 10 000 K, fond en vol (~ 5 -150 ms) et se resolidifie en gouttelette sphérique sous l'effet de la tension de surface.

La qualité finale des poudres dépend de quatre paramètres opératoires principaux : la puissance du procédé, le débit de poudre, les débits de gaz (central, gaine, porteur), et la position axiale de la sonde d'injection de poudre dans le plasma. Sur la torche TekSphero40 (20-40 kW) et pour l'AlSi10Mg, trois verrous scientifiques sont identifiés et doivent être levés simultanément :

• Verrou 1 :

Coalescence des particules : les gouttelettes fondues, en raison de leur faible viscosité, fusionnent lors de collisions en vol, provoquant un grossissement non contrôlé de la distribution granulométrique. Ceci a été particulièrement observé dans nos essais sur la sphéroïdisation de AlSi10Mg. Dans la littérature, cet effet a été rapporté sur une poudre de tungstène (Zhu et al. 2017).

• Verrou 2 :

Évaporation des éléments légers : le magnésium (Tvap = 1091 °C) s'évapore préférentiellement dans le plasma, provoquant un appauvrissement en Mg de l'alliage (perte de la phase durcissante Mg₂Si) et la formation de fumées métalliques.

• Verrou 3 :

Formation de nanoparticules : les vapeurs métalliques produite dans le plasma conduisent à la condensation en nanoparticules polluantes et parfois, de dépôts satellites sur les grosses particules.

Ces trois verrous sont couplés : augmenter la puissance ou le temps de séjour améliore la sphéricité mais aggrave la coalescence et l'évaporation. Le problème est intrinsèquement multi-objectifs et aucune solution "toute faite" n'existe dans la littérature pour cet alliage.

MISSION ET ACTIVITES

Le post-doc développera un modèle permettant de prédire le comportement des particules dans le plasma en considérant trois phénomènes physiques principaux :

• Fusion et sphéroïdisation : établir le bilan énergétique entre le plasma et les particules afin de déterminer les conditions permettant leur fusion complète et leur transformation en particules sphériques.

• Évaporation du magnésium : modéliser la perte préférentielle de Mg lorsque les particules atteignent des températures élevées, en reliant température, temps de séjour et cinétique d'évaporation.

• Coalescence : étudier les collisions et la fusion entre particules en vol afin de prédire leur évolution granulométrique.

Ces trois phénomènes seront ensuite couplés dans une approche d'optimisation multi-objectifs, afin d'identifier les conditions permettant de maximiser la sphéroïdisation tout en limitant la perte de Mg, la formation de nanoparticules et l'élargissement de la distribution granulométrique.

Le travail comportera une forte interaction entre modélisation et expérimentation. Les prédictions seront confrontées à des essais réalisés sur la TekSphero-40 et à la caractérisation des poudres par MEB, diffraction laser, mesure de densité apparente et ICP-AES. Un plan d'expériences sera notamment utilisé pour calibrer et valider les modèles.

Activités principales :

1.Acquérir des connaissances sur le procédé de sphéroïdisation plasma RF

2.Développer les modèles physiques

3. Développer une approche de modélisation numérique

4. Mettre en œuvre une stratégie d'optimisation

5.Conduire et analyser les expérimentations


Diplôme requis pour les contractuels : doctorat

Spécialité/domaine (facultatif) : génie des procédés, génie mécanique, science et génie des matériaux, métallurgie, physique des plasmas, thermique et énergétique, mécanique des fluides ou domaine scientifique proche. Une expérience directe en plasma thermique ou en sphéroïdisation de poudres serait appréciée, mais elle n'est pas indispensable. Le candidat devra surtout posséder une solide formation scientifique lui permettant d'acquérir rapidement les connaissances spécifiques au procédé.

Connaissances :

Le/la candidat(e) devra disposer de bonnes bases dans plusieurs des domaines suivants : transferts thermiques, thermodynamique, mécanique des fluides, phénomènes de transport, science des matériaux et métallurgie, modélisation physique, méthodes numériques, statistiques et plans d'expériences.

Une bonne compréhension des phénomènes de changement de phase, de transfert de chaleur, de transport de matière et de cinétique est particulièrement recherchée.

Le projet nécessite également une capacité à passer d'une description physique du phénomène à un modèle mathématique exploitable numériquement.

Savoir-être :

Nous recherchons un(e) jeune chercheur(se) autonome, curieux(se) et capable d'aborder un problème physique complexe, de formuler des hypothèses, de développer un modèle, de le confronter à l'expérience et de l'améliorer sur la base des résultats obtenus.

Aircall is a unicorn, AI-powered customer communications platform used by 22,000+ companies worldwide to drive revenue, resolve issues faster, and scale customer-facing teams. We’re redefining customer communications by bringing voice, SMS, WhatsApp, and AI together into one seamless workspace.

Our momentum comes from a simple idea: help teams work smarter, not harder. Aircall’s AI Voice Agent automates routine calls, AI Assist streamlines post-call work, and AI Assist Pro delivers real-time guidance so people can do their best work. The result is higher revenue, faster resolutions, and teams that scale with confidence.

Aircall is headquartered in Paris, our European HQ, with a strong North American presence anchored in Seattle, our North American HQ, and teams across Madrid, London, Berlin, San Francisco, New York City, Sydney, and Mexico City. We’ve built a product customers love and a business that’s scaling quickly, backed by world-class investors and driven by rapid AI innovation across multiple product lines.
At Aircall, you’ll join a company in motion. We’re ambitious, product-driven, and execution-focused, with visible impact, fast decisions, and real growth.

How we work at Aircall: We’re customer-obsessed, data-driven, and focused on delivering meaningful outcomes. We value ownership, continuous learning, and thoughtful speed. If you thrive in a collaborative, fast-moving environment where trust and impact matter, you’ll feel at home here.

We're looking for a Senior Revenue Operations Business Partner to serve as the dedicated operational partner to the GM, EMEA. In this role, you'll be the connective tissue between the EMEA go-to-market (GTM) organization and Global Revenue Operations (RevOps), owning the operating cadence, surfacing the insights that drive decisions, and turning regional strategy into executable plans.

You'll support the full EMEA GTM motion across Business Development Representative (BDR), Account Executive (AE), Partner Account Manager (PAM), Account Manager (AM), Solutions Engineer (SE), Customer Engineer (CE), and Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) functions, spanning four Areas: FIME, UKI, DACH, and Iberia. You'll run the forecast and QBR cadence, own analytics and insights for the region, drive process improvement, and feed regional learnings back into the Global RevOps Center of Excellence, so best practices scale across the business.

This is a high-visibility role for someone who can move fluently between the boardroom and the spreadsheet — equally comfortable facilitating an executive forecast review and building the capacity model underneath it.


What you will do:

  • Act as the trusted operational partner to the GM, EMEA, owning the region's GTM operating model and rhythm of business

  • Run the EMEA forecast process end to end — preparing, facilitating, and following up on weekly forecast calls across the four Areas (FIME, UKI, DACH, Iberia)

  • Own the quarterly business review (QBR) cadence: structure, narrative, data, and readouts for regional and executive audiences

  • Deliver analytics and insights across the full EMEA GTM funnel (BDR, AE, PAM, AM, SE, CE, FDE), translating data into clear, actionable recommendations

  • Lead process improvement initiatives that increase seller productivity, pipeline health, and forecast accuracy

  • Partner with the Global RevOps Center of Excellence, providing regional inputs and adopting standardized best practices, tooling, and methodologies

  • Drive annual planning for EMEA, including territory design, segmentation, and capacity/headcount modeling

  • Support quota setting, coverage models, and GTM design in partnership with Sales, Finance, and the broader RevOps team

  • Maintain data quality and operational discipline across the region's systems and reporting


    • What we're looking for:

  • 5+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Strategy & Operations, or a comparable analytical/commercial role, ideally within a high-growth B2B SaaS environment

  • Strong experience supporting a multi-segment, multi-country GTM organization across direct, partner, and post-sales motions

  • Demonstrated ownership of forecasting, pipeline management, and QBR processes at a regional or business-unit level

  • Excellent analytical skills — fluency with Salesforce and BI/reporting tools (Looker, Hex); comfort building capacity, territory, and segmentation models

  • Experience with annual planning, including territory and quota design

  • Exceptional stakeholder management — credible with senior commercial leaders and able to influence without authority

  • Strong communication and storytelling skills; able to turn complex data into a clear executive narrative

  • A bias for action, comfort with ambiguity, and the ability to operate independently in a fast-moving environment

  • Fluency in English required; additional European languages (French, German, Spanish) a plus

title: Senior Customer Success Engineer
Senior Account Executive - Enterprise Sales
Chef de projet Activation B2B (H/F/X) - France (Paris)
description:
Votre Rôle

Au sein de l'équipe B2B France, vous contribuez au développement et à l’engagement de notre réseau de professionnels de santé en construisant et pilotant des activations B2B adaptées aux besoins du marché français.

Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les Regional Managers afin d’identifier les besoins du terrain, de les transformer en initiatives pertinentes et, lorsque cela est possible, de les déployer à l’échelle du réseau.

  • Construire et piloter le plan d’activation B2B en définissant un calendrier annuel de campagnes, programmes et initiatives destinés aux professionnels de santé, en lien avec les priorités business

  • Concevoir les parcours partenaires en développant les parcours d’onboarding, d’engagement, de développement et de réactivation adaptés aux différents profils et niveaux de maturité des professionnels

  • Développer des programmes d’engagement et de développement du réseau, notamment autour de campagnes thématiques, lancements produits, réactivation, challenges, formations ou initiatives saisonnières

  • Piloter le déploiement des programmes en collaboration avec les Regional Managers vous déployez les initiatives auprès des partenaires, recueillez leurs retours et adaptez les dispositifs aux besoins du terrain

  • Développer l’activation CRM B2B en segmentant la base de professionnels et en mettant en place des communications et scénarios permettant d’accompagner les partenaires tout au long de leur parcours

  • Mesurer la performance des activations et identifier les opportunités d’amélioration, afin d’optimiser continuellement l’engagement du réseau et leur contribution au développement du marché français

Votre Profil

  • Vous êtes diplômé(e) d’une formation avec orientation scientifique (nutrition, biologie, santé ou domaine similaire) et vous disposez d’une première expérience en marketing ou gestion de projet

  • Vous avez une réelle capacité à comprendre, synthétiser et vulgariser des informations scientifiques et à les transformer en contenus clairs, pédagogiques et pertinents pour des professionnels de santé

  • Vous êtes organisé(e), autonome et capable de piloter plusieurs projets simultanément, tout en coordonnant différentes parties prenantes

  • Vous avez une approche à la fois analytique et orientée business : vous savez identifier les priorités, mesurer les résultats et transformer les apprentissages en actions concrètes

  • Vous aimez travailler de manière transverse et savez transformer des besoins provenant du terrain en solutions structurées et scalables

  • Vous parlez couramment français et anglais (à l'écrit comme à l'oral)

À noter : L'anglais étant notre langue d'entreprise, la communication avec le siège ainsi que les premiers entretiens se dérouleront en anglais

Ce que nous offrons

  • Une réduction attractive sur l'ensemble de nos produits - des huiles essentielles aux vitamines et nutriments.

  • 25 jours de congés payés par an, complétés par jusqu'à 5 jours de repos offerts entre Noël et le Nouvel An.

  • Parce que les plus belles réussites naissent des rencontres, nous adoptons un modèle hybride avec un jour de télétravail par semaine (jusqu'à deux selon votre département) et la possibilité de travailler jusqu'à deux semaines par an depuis l'étranger.

  • Une réelle autonomie, un terrain propice aux initiatives, ainsi que l'opportunité d'apporter votre expertise et de concrétiser vos meilleures idées.

  • Des espaces de travail accueillants avec un accès privilégié à une large sélection de thés biologiques et de superfoods du monde entier.

  • Nous aimons célébrer nos succès ensemble ! Événements réguliers, tea parties, fêtes de Noël et d'été, ainsi que diverses activations influenceurs (comme pour la Journée internationale des droits des femmes).

Postulez en envoyant votre CV et votre lettre de motivation - idéalement en anglais.

B2B Marketing Activation Manager (all genders) - France (Paris)

Your role

As part of the French B2B team, you will contribute to the development and engagement of our healthcare professional network by building and managing B2B activations tailored to the needs of the French market.

You will work closely with the Regional Managers to identify needs from the field, turn them into relevant initiatives and, whenever possible, deploy them across the wider network.

  • Build and lead the B2B activation plan by defining an annual calendar of campaigns, programs and initiatives targeting healthcare professionals, aligned with business priorities

  • Design partner journeys by developing onboarding, engagement, development and reactivation journeys tailored to the different profiles and levels of maturity of our healthcare professionals

  • Develop network engagement and development programs, including thematic campaigns, product launches, reactivation initiatives, challenges, trainings and seasonal initiatives

  • Lead program deployment by working closely with Regional Managers to roll out initiatives to partners, gather feedback and adapt programs to field needs

  • Develop B2B CRM activation by segmenting the healthcare professional database and implementing communications and journeys that support partners throughout their relationship with Sunday Natural

  • Measure activation performance and identify opportunities for improvement to continuously optimize network engagement and their contribution to the development of the French market

Your profile

  • You have a scientific background or degree in nutrition, biology, healthcare or a similar field and you have initial experience in marketing or project management

  • You have a strong ability to understand, synthesize and communicate scientific information in an accessible way, and transform it into clear, educational and relevant content for healthcare professionals

  • You are organized, autonomous and able to manage multiple projects simultaneously, while coordinating different stakeholders

  • You have both an analytical and business-oriented mindset: you know how to identify priorities, measure results and turn learnings into concrete actions

  • You enjoy working cross-functionally and are able to turn field needs into structured and scalable solutions

  • Fluency in French and English (written and spoken)

Please note: As English is our company language, internal communication and initial interviews will take place in English.

What we offer

  • An appealing discount on all of our products – from essential oils to vitamins & nutrients

  • We offer 25 days of paid time off per year plus up to 5 days off between Christmas and New Year

  • We believe great things happen when we meet in person, which is why we embrace a hybrid model with one home office day per week – up to two depending on the area you are working in – and up to two weeks per year working from abroad

  • You will be given real ownership and plenty of room for new initiatives, as well as the opportunity to contribute your expertise and implement your great ideas

  • Inviting office spaces with access to plenty of organic teas and superfoods from around the world

  • We like to celebrate each other! Regular tea & office parties, Christmas and summer feasts and various influencer events such as Women's Day

Apply with your CV and cover letter.

Sunday Natural emerged from a long-standing passion and research in the fields of health, healing, and personal growth. The lack of natural, high-quality products on the market was the original motivation for founding Sunday Natural in 2013. We aim to produce the products we ourselves would love to buy – as natural as possible, absolutely pure, free from any additives, and of the highest quality. In a strategic partnership with CVC, Sunday Natural is now one of Germany's most renowned quality manufacturers, with its own research and development department in Berlin. title: Growth Engineer (Intern)
description:
👷🏻‍♀️ What we do 👷🏻‍♀️

At Emidat, we are building the first climate-native product management system for building material manufacturers. We aim to decarbonise building materials, making up 11% of global GHG emissions. We collect data from physical production processes, generate a digital product passport with verified environmental data and make it usable along the value chain. In short: One solution to assess, design, buy, sell and manage products - with environmental impact at the core.

With this, we are building the digital infrastructure to make it faster, easier, and more sustainable to build the world around us.

Find out more about us, the team and our values here.

What you will work on

Your mission

Drive initiatives that grow Emidat. In Growth we prioritise by one question: does this bring in new customers? As a Growth Engineer Intern you work across our four growth functions that sits closest to that answer; 1. Growth Engineering, 2. Growth Marketing, 3. Sales Development and 4. Partnerships

Topics you might work on: our automated campaign planning and lead development process, and the automations behind it. Our mapping of the total addressable market (TAM) and the GTM analysis sheet we use to decide which segments and countries to go after. Our industry get-togethers, for example expert exchanges and C-level breakfasts, from the invite list to the follow-up. LinkedIn posts and customer case studies, which means talking to manufacturers who use Emidat and turning what they tell you into material our sales team can send.

This internship is ideal for someone who has future aspirations to ‘found’ a company. Building a revenue function is one of the most difficult parts of founding, and during your internship, you’ll get insights into how demand is created, how a pipeline is built, and how AI actually optimises a go-to-market team. You will work on initiatives with the leads of each growth function, including our Head of Growth. We expect you to work independently, form your own view on what to prioritise, and challenge us when you think we have it wrong.

 

During your Internship, you will:

Joining our Growth team involves:

  • Own our Campaign Process: Run and sharpen the automated workflow that qualifies and enriches our target accounts, and take responsibility for the pipeline our SDR team works from.

  • Map our Market: Extend our TAM mapping into every new geography we enter, and keep our view of the relevant manufacturers, associations and registries current - so the commercial team always plans against a reliable picture of who is worth targeting.

  • Turn Data into Decisions: Build and maintain the reporting our team steers by, from campaign performance to pipeline health. Translate data into clear, actionable insights and own the data quality that makes those numbers trustworthy.

  • Organise our industry get-togethers: Organise formats like the BAU Dinner, our C-level AI Breakfasts and the Climate Native Summit end-to-end - guest list, invitations, on-site logistics and follow-up - turning each one into a reliable source of senior conversations.

  • Build Our Market Presence: Draft posts for our company page and keep our content calendar running: webinars and event announcements, product news, new joiners, and the pieces that build our positioning in the market.

Internal Tech Stack:

CRM: Hubspot

Automation: N8N, Clay

Outreach: Lemlist, LinkedIn Sales Navigator

AI Tooling: Claude Co-work/Code
Content & design: LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Figma

Messaging: Slack & Google Workspace

What you will bring to this role

Minimum Requirements

  • Language: Fluent (C2/Native) in German and business fluent (C1+) in English.

  • Data-Driven System Integration: Proven ability to interpret complex performance data, generating actionable insights that directly inform strategy. You must be able to effectively bridge data analysis with our internal tech stack to drive business outcomes.

  • Proactive & Strategic Problem-Solving: A track record of independently identifying and resolving operational bottlenecks in processes, leading to measurable improvements in efficiency.

  • Operational Excellence & Project Ownership: Exceptional organisational skills with a demonstrated capability to manage multiple, high-priority projects concurrently, ensuring successful delivery within tight deadlines.

Nice to have’s

  • Educational Background: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a relevant field.

  • Expertise in Growth Stack Technologies: Hands-on experience and familiarity with core automation, analytics, and CRM systems, including specific platforms like Hubspot, N8N, Clay, Lemlist, and Make.

  • Content & Social: Experience running a company's or organisation's LinkedIn presence, or writing experience with an audience behind it - a newsletter or blog of your own.

  • Start-up Experience: Experience in a commercial or operational role in a startup or scaleup.

     

How we support you

Your team lead will be

  • Katharina Mas (Growth Engineer)

You will work with

  • Janos Gründling (Head of Growth)

  • Elise Lecocq (Sales Development)

  • Sara Power Millán (Partnerships)

  • Isabel Bommes Fernandez (Team Lead, Go-to-Market)

  • Sina Zamorano (Team Lead, Climate Success)
