title: Product Manager – Android Integration & Ecosystem
description:
Your mission

As our Product Manager – Android Integration & Ecosystem, you will define the product what and why for how ProGlove devices connect, integrate and create value within the enterprise Android ecosystem.

ProGlove is evolving from a wearable scanner company into a Worker Companion company, bringing together ergonomic wearable hardware, software, connectivity, workflow guidance, data and intelligence. With the MAI Wearable Companion, we are entering a broader ecosystem of enterprise applications, technologies, standards, partners and customer infrastructure.

Your mission will be to make our products easy to adopt, integrate and deploy at scale – without turning every customer opportunity into a bespoke engineering project. You will identify recurring customer needs, translate them into scalable capabilities and propositions, and decide where ProGlove should own, enable or partner. In doing so, you will help turn integration from a technical necessity into a source of differentiation, customer value and commercial opportunity.

You will work closely with the Product Manager responsible for the Wearable Companion device. While they own the device proposition, you will own how the device connects to and creates value in the wider ecosystem. Together, you will shape a coherent end-to-end proposition for customers, developers, integrators and partners.

Your day-to-day 
  • Define and evolve the product strategy and priorities for ProGlove’s enterprise Android integration and ecosystem capabilities, aligned with customer needs and business goals.
  • Work directly with customers, Sales and Solution Architecture to identify recurring problems, distinguish individual requests from broader market needs and turn the right opportunities into scalable solutions.
  • Translate recurring integration needs into repeatable product capabilities such as APIs, SDKs, tools, interfaces, documentation, integration patterns and deployment solutions.
  • Shape the product experience around device setup, provisioning, application distribution, device management and other capabilities required to deploy and operate connected device fleets at scale.
  • Make clear, pragmatic decisions about where ProGlove should own, enable or partner, balancing customer value, strategic control, speed, scalability and technical complexity.
  • Identify the platforms, applications, standards and ecosystem players that matter to our customers, and shape the integrations, certifications and technology partnerships that strengthen our proposition.
  • Explore where integration capabilities, software, services and ecosystem propositions can create differentiated value and support commercial or recurring-revenue opportunities.
  • Partner closely with Engineering and the Product Manager for the Wearable Companion to create alignment on customer problems, priorities, trade-offs and desired outcomes.
  • Enable Sales and other customer-facing teams to clearly explain our Android proposition, supported capabilities, integrations and common deployment patterns.
  • Maintain a forward-looking view of enterprise Android, AOSP, enterprise mobility, AI and adjacent technologies, and translate relevant developments into strategic options and product priorities.


Your profile

At ProGlove, technical expertise matters, but how you work is just as important. We are looking for someone who takes ownership, stays curious, collaborates openly and turns complexity into clear, pragmatic decisions.

  • You bring strong Product Management experience in B2B or enterprise technology and can define strategy, discover meaningful customer problems, prioritize opportunities and turn them into scalable products or propositions.
  • You are commercially minded and naturally connect product decisions with customer value, differentiation, business impact and opportunities to capture value.
  • You are comfortable working with enterprise software, platforms, connected devices, integrations or technology ecosystems, and understand the realities of complex customer IT environments.
  • You have enough technical depth to understand architecture, interfaces and trade-offs, contribute credibly to platform and integration discussions, and recognize when deeper engineering expertise is needed.
  • You think in systems and patterns: when faced with a customer requirement, you look beyond the immediate request to understand why it exists, how broadly it applies and what a simple, repeatable solution could look like.
  • You take end-to-end ownership, move topics forward without waiting for perfect instructions and remain effective when the product space or path ahead is not yet fully defined.
  • You collaborate generously and build trust across Product, Engineering, Sales, Solution Architecture, customers and external partners. You can create alignment and drive decisions without relying on formal authority.
  • You communicate clearly and transparently, raise risks early and can make complex technical and commercial topics understandable to different audiences.
  • You are curious about customers, the business and emerging technologies, and continuously test assumptions rather than pursuing technology for its own sake.
  • You use pragmatic judgment to balance speed, simplicity, quality and long-term value.
  • You are fluent in English and comfortable working in an international environment.

Experience in one or more of the following areas would be valuable, but is not required:

  • Enterprise Android, AOSP or adjacent Android ecosystems, including environments operating outside standard Google Mobile Services.
  • Enterprise mobility management, MDM/EMM, device provisioning, application deployment or connected fleet management.
  • Rugged or industrial devices, IoT or edge devices, connected hardware or other B2B technology ecosystems.
  • APIs, SDKs, developer or integrator experiences and enterprise integrations.
  • Platform or ecosystem strategy, technology partnerships, certification programs or developer and partner ecosystems.
  • Enterprise customers deploying technology at scale.
Direct Android Product Management experience is an advantage, but not essential if you bring strong Product Management expertise and relevant experience from an adjacent enterprise technology ecosystem.


Why us?

This is an opportunity to shape an important part of a category that is still being defined. 
Android gives ProGlove access to a much broader technology ecosystem, but the opportunity goes far beyond compatibility. You will help determine what role ProGlove should play in that ecosystem, which capabilities we should own, where we should partner, what customers and developers should be able to build around us, and where integration itself can become a source of differentiation and recurring business value. 
ProGlove already has the customer base, market credibility, technology and industrial expertise to build on. Our products are used in some of the world's most demanding operational environments. What we are now building is the next layer. 
Over time, success will mean more than making our own products easier to integrate. It will mean creating capabilities, interfaces and ecosystem relationships that customers, application providers and partners actively choose to build around - moving ProGlove from ecosystem participant toward ecosystem shaper. 
If you are excited by the idea of turning complex technology ecosystems into simple, valuable products - and helping shape how the next generation of frontline technology connects with the digital world - we would love to meet you. 
Join us in building the future of frontline work.


What success looks like

  • ProGlove has a clear, customer-backed strategy and prioritized roadmap for Android integration and ecosystem capabilities.
  • Recurring customer and integration needs are turned into scalable, repeatable solutions rather than one-off engineering projects.
  • Customers can adopt, integrate, deploy and manage ProGlove devices more easily within their existing enterprise environments.
  • Decisions about what ProGlove should own, enable or partner are made transparently and based on customer value, business impact and long-term scalability.
  • Product, Engineering, Sales and Solution Architecture are aligned on priorities, supported capabilities and key trade-offs.
  • Customer-facing teams can confidently communicate our Android proposition and common deployment patterns without relying on Product or Engineering in every opportunity.

Our compensation package includes equity, giving you the opportunity to share in what we build.

  • Training role: £13 per hour while you complete the required training and sign-off.

  • Qualified role: £15 per hour in total compensation, including equity, once you have completed the required training and are qualified and signed off for the role.

Our Team


Since 2021 our team has been listed every year in the “Top 100 Startups worth watching” in the EE Times in 2021 and 2022, and our technology breakthroughs have been featured in The Telegraph, BBC and the New Statesman. Our founders are internationally renowned researchers from UCL and Oxford University who have pioneered the development of qubits and quantum computing architectures. We’re backed by a team of top-tier investors, and we have recently closed our Series C funding of $160 million.

 

We bring together the brightest quantum engineers, integrated circuit (IC) engineers, quantum computing theoreticians and software engineers to create a unique, world-leading team, working together closely to maximise our combined expertise. Our collaborative and interdisciplinary culture is an ideal fit for anyone who thrives in a cutting-edge research and development environment focused on tackling big challenges and contributing to the development of scalable quantum computers based on silicon technology.

 

This is a rare and exciting opportunity to be an employee at a scale-up shaping the future of quantum computing. There are vast opportunities for professional growth and to make an impact within the company. 

Our team of 100+ is based across London, Oxford, San Sebastián and Sydney, with our primary hub in Islington (London).

We are looking for a Senior Electrical Characterisation Engineer to join our Process Integration team and play a key role in understanding, qualifying and improving the silicon devices at the heart of our quantum processors.

You will sit at a fascinating intersection between semiconductor manufacturing and quantum hardware, working closely with foundries, process engineers and quantum engineers.

You will use electrical characterisation and large-scale data analysis to understand manufacturing variability, identify the root causes of device behaviour, and feed those insights directly back into the semiconductor fabrication process.

This is an opportunity to have a tangible impact on the yield, quality and scalability of quantum processors, working with some of the most advanced silicon technology being developed for quantum computing.


Functions of the Role

  • Drive electrical characterisation of fabricated silicon devices, developing and continuously improving high-throughput screening methods to assess key device parameters including threshold voltage, gate oxide reliability and channel mobility.

  • Turn electrical data into manufacturing insight, identifying patterns, variability and device failures and connecting them back to semiconductor process steps such as photolithography, etching, oxide growth, CMP and doping.

  • Develop automated measurement and test infrastructure, creating robust Python-based test routines and instrument-control workflows across room-temperature and, where appropriate, low-temperature wafer probing environments.

  • Analyse large-scale electrical datasets using statistical process control, yield analysis and other data-driven techniques to monitor wafer uniformity, defect density and process drift.

  • Work directly with semiconductor foundries and process engineers, providing clear, actionable feedback that can be used to improve device performance, consistency and yield.

  • Build scalable characterisation processes, establishing testing standards, calibration procedures, SOPs and data pipelines that allow information to flow effectively between semiconductor process integration and quantum engineering teams.

  • Help shape how we characterise the next generation of our technology, bringing your expertise and ideas to continuously improve our measurement capability as Quantum Motion scales.

  • We are looking for someone who combines strong semiconductor device knowledge with a practical, data-driven approach to electrical characterisation.


Experience - Essentials


  • Master's or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Microelectronics, Semiconductor Physics, Materials Science or a closely related discipline.

  • 3+ years' experience in semiconductor device testing, reliability engineering, electrical characterisation or yield analysis within a foundry, IDM or semiconductor R&D environment.

  • Strong understanding of silicon CMOS fabrication processes, semiconductor device physics and foundry workflows.

  • Hands-on experience with semiconductor parameter analysers, SMUs and wafer probe stations, including DC and/or RF electrical testing.

  • Strong Python skills, particularly for instrument control, automation and automated test execution.

  • A highly analytical approach and the ability to work with large datasets to identify trends, anomalies and root causes.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across semiconductor, process, hardware and quantum engineering teams.


Experience - Desirable

It would be particularly valuable if you also have experience in:

  • Quantum device physics, including quantum dots, single-electron transistors (SETs) or charge-stability mapping.

  • Cryogenic electrical characterisation and low-temperature measurement systems.

description:
About Us

We are building Physics AI for hardware design. Our software platform helps hardware designers and physics simulation engineers explore, analyze, and optimize hardware systems, leveraging cutting-edge AI to deliver ultrafast, accurate physics intelligence within the realities of engineering design workflows.

Our first product bridges the gap between the accuracy & determinism of traditional simulation and the speed & scaling of AI, and is redefining how the world’s most advanced semiconductors are designed, verified, built, brought to market and integrated in complex systems.

Role Overview

As a pivotal leader within our European Forward Deployment team, you will drive the adoption of Vinci’s platform among the region's top engineering organizations. In this strategic role, you will build, mentor, and guide a high-performing team of thermal engineers dedicated to engaging prospective customers and demonstrating our software's transformative value.

As trusted technical advisors, you and your team will use deep simulation expertise to help enterprise customers validate and optimize complex, real-world designs. Through these collaborative engagements, you will champion Vinci's value proposition by showing how our platform delivers systemic improvements in thermal performance, product reliability, and time-to-market.

Leveraging strong fundamentals in continuum mechanics, you will guide analyses of complex physical phenomena, including linear, geometric and material nonlinearities, and contact interactions. Your team will evaluate critical factors such as warpage, stress evolution, thermal cycling, and reliability across advanced semiconductor devices, electronics packages, and wafer-scale systems.

You will work closely with customer engineering teams to understand their technical challenges, provide expert guidance, and clearly articulate Vinci’s capabilities in solving real-world problems. You will also serve as a key feedback channel to product and engineering teams, translating customer insights into actionable inputs that shape product direction and drive continuous improvement.

This is a remote role, with close collaboration with Sales, Product, and Engineering in Palo Alto, CA, USA. The role includes moderate travel, primarily within continental Europe. Some infrequent intercontinental travel may be required for discussions and collaboration with the US team.

Responsibilities

  • Build, lead, and scale a high-performing team of thermo-mechanical engineers, setting the technical direction, hiring, mentoring team members, and driving field execution across Europe.

  • Collaborate closely with the sales team to lead technical discussions, scope proof-of-concept (PoC) evaluations, and deliver compelling product demonstrations to prospective enterprise customers.

  • Guide customer engineering teams through the evaluation phase by overseeing simulation setup, running complex test cases, and interpreting results to explicitly prove Vinci’s technical and business value.

  • Own customer enablement through onboarding, deployment pipeline and account expansion, providing senior technical guidance, structured training sessions, and advanced troubleshooting.

  • Provide product guidance and feedback, identify customer pain points and workflow bottlenecks, partnering directly with internal product and engineering teams to transform field feedback into critical new product features.

  • Represent Vinci at major industry conferences and semiconductor events, engaging technically with key prospects and partners through technical presentations and live platform demonstrations.

  • Maintain a strong understanding of competitive technologies, industry trends, and market positioning to communicate Vinci’s differentiators effectively.

Qualifications (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Education: Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a closely related technical field.

  • Technical depth: Expert-level mastery of commercial simulation software (Asys, Abaqus, or equivalent), with 15+ years of hands-on experience in thermo-mechanical simulations— either as a practitioner running simulations or as a technical account manager for commercial physics simulation software.

  • Industry Domain: Deep familiarity with semiconductor electronics packaging, advanced packaging technologies (e.g., 2.5D/3D IC), or foundry ecosystems.

  • Customer Engagement: Prior experience in dedicated customer-facing roles, with a strong ability to build trust and manage engineering client relationships.

  • Automation & Scripting: Practical programming experience using Python or C++ to automate workflows or parse simulation data.

  • Leadership Impact: Proven track record of prior managerial or technical leadership experience, with the ability to scale, mentor, and drive execution across engineering teams.

  • Communication: Elite interpersonal and communication skills, with a proven ability to distill complex physics and simulation results into clear, high-impact narratives for both deep technical panels and business-oriented executives.

Preferred (Desirable Differentiators)

  • Multiphysics Breadth: Familiarity with thermal solutions management and/or Electrical Signal Integrity and Power Integrity (SI/PI) workflows.

  • Commercial Track Record: Direct experience commercializing technical software—ideally electronic design automation (EDA) or CAE simulation tools—into major semiconductor and electronics enterprises.

  • Go-To-Market Experience: Prior experience explicitly within technical pre-sales, application engineering (FAE), or strategic technical sales environments.

  • Emerging Tech Adjacency: Ability to rapidly adopt and champion next-generation, physics-based workflows and AI-assisted design or simulation tools.

Why Join Us

  • Not just use AI; be part of a team actively redefining how next-generation silicon and hardware are architected.

  • Work at the absolute convergence of state-of-the-art AI models, fundamental physics, and high-stakes enterprise

  • Collaborate with world-class engineers and researchers in a fast-moving startup environment.Ingénieur / Ingénieure principal/e en thermomécanique (H/F) — Paris/Grenoble

    À propos de Vinci

    Vinci développe une IA fondée sur la physique (Physics AI) pour la conception de systèmes hardware. Notre plateforme donne aux équipes de conception et de simulation des prédictions physiques précises, obtenues en une fraction du temps d'une simulation classique, et qui s'intègrent à leurs outils existants.

    C'est la première solution à offrir à la fois la rigueur de la simulation traditionnelle et la vitesse de l'IA. Elle transforme la façon dont les semi-conducteurs les plus avancés au monde sont conçus, vérifiés, fabriqués, mis sur le marché et intégrés dans des systèmes complexes.

    Présentation du poste

    En tant que membre clé de notre équipe européenne de Forward Deployment, vous jouerez un rôle déterminant dans l'adoption de la plateforme Vinci par les principales organisations d'ingénierie de la région. Dans ce rôle stratégique, vous constituerez, accompagnerez et dirigerez une équipe performante de spécialistes en ingénierie thermique, chargée d'accompagner nos clients et prospects et de démontrer concrètement la valeur de notre logiciel.

    En tant que référent technique de confiance auprès de nos clients, vous et votre équipe mettrez à profit votre expertise approfondie en simulation pour aider nos clients industriels à valider et optimiser des conceptions complexes dans des conditions représentatives de leurs applications réelles. À travers ces collaborations, vous démontrerez comment la plateforme Vinci permet d'améliorer les performances thermiques et la fiabilité des produits, tout en accélérant les cycles de conception et la mise sur le marché.

    Grâce à votre solide maîtrise de la mécanique des milieux continus, vous guiderez l'analyse de phénomènes physiques complexes : comportements linéaires, non-linéarités géométriques et matérielles, et interactions de contact. Votre équipe aidera les clients à évaluer des paramètres critiques tels que le warpage, l'évolution des contraintes, le cyclage thermique et la fiabilité, sur des composants semi-conducteurs avancés, des packages électroniques et des systèmes à l'échelle du wafer.

    Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes d'ingénierie de nos clients afin de comprendre leurs problématiques techniques, de leur apporter une expertise approfondie et de démontrer clairement comment Vinci peut répondre à leurs cas d'usage concrets. Vous jouerez également un rôle essentiel d'interface entre les clients et nos équipes Product et Engineering, en transformant les retours du terrain en informations exploitables pour orienter la feuille de route produit et contribuer à l'amélioration continue de la plateforme.

    Ce poste est basé en France et exercé en télétravail, avec une collaboration étroite avec les équipes Sales, Product et Engineering basées à Palo Alto, en Californie. Il implique des déplacements réguliers mais modérés, principalement en Europe continentale, ainsi que des déplacements occasionnels aux États-Unis pour collaborer avec l'équipe américaine.

    Responsabilités

    • Construire, diriger et développer une équipe performante d'ingénieur/es en thermomécanique, en définissant l'orientation technique, en recrutant et accompagnant les membres de l'équipe, et en pilotant l'exécution sur le terrain à travers l'Europe.

    • Collaborer étroitement avec l'équipe Sales pour diriger les discussions techniques, définir le périmètre des évaluations en proof-of-concept (PoC) et réaliser des démonstrations de produits convaincantes auprès de clients industriels potentiels.

    • Accompagner les équipes d'ingénierie des clients pendant la phase d'évaluation en supervisant la mise en place des simulations, l'exécution de cas de test complexes et l'interprétation des résultats afin de démontrer concrètement la valeur technique et business de Vinci.

    • Piloter l'accompagnement technique des clients, notamment l'onboarding, le déploiement et l'expansion des comptes, en fournissant une expertise technique de haut niveau, des sessions de formation structurées et un support avancé pour la résolution des problèmes.

    • Fournir des orientations et des retours sur le produit, identifier les difficultés rencontrées par les clients et les points de friction dans leurs workflows, et collaborer directement avec les équipes Produit et Engineering internes afin de transformer les retours du terrain en fonctionnalités produit clés.

    • Représenter Vinci lors de grandes conférences industrielles et d'événements dédiés aux semi-conducteurs, en échangeant avec des prospects et partenaires stratégiques à travers des présentations techniques et des démonstrations en direct de la plateforme.

    • Maintenir une excellente compréhension des technologies concurrentes, des tendances du secteur et du positionnement du marché afin de communiquer efficacement les éléments différenciants de Vinci.

    Qualifications (Qualifications minimales)

    Formation : Diplôme d'ingénieur ou équivalent (Master, doctorat) en génie mécanique, génie électrique ou dans un domaine technique étroitement lié.

description:
Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c’est s’engager dans une institution où la science et l’innovation bâtissent un avenir plus durable. Une école d’excellence où chacun a l’opportunité de révéler son plein potentiel et de contribuer à relever les défis de demain.

Classée parmi les meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France et reconnue mondialement, notre école, membre de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, forme les talents de demain tout en contribuant activement à relever les grands défis industriels, numériques et environnementaux. Avec nous, vous intégrez une communauté de 500 collaborateurs, 2500 étudiants, et participez à un projet ambitieux : conjuguer excellence académique, recherche d’avant-garde et impact sociétal positif.

L’Institut Mines-Télécom fédère les grandes écoles françaises autour des défis industriels majeurs, numériques, énergétiques et écologiques. Avec ses 8 Grandes Écoles publiques et 2 écoles filiales, il est le premier institut public dédié aux ingénieurs et managers. Ensemble, nous imaginons et construisons un avenir durable, en formant les acteurs qui façonneront les transitions de demain.

À Mines Saint-Étienne, nos centres de recherche sont le cœur battant de notre École.

Pensés comme de véritables hubs d’innovation, nos cinq Centres de Formation et de Recherche articulent leurs expertises autour de grands enjeux industriels, environnementaux, sociétaux et technologiques.

Leur mission ? Imaginer le monde de demain en alliant excellence académique et impact concret.

Quand la technologie rencontre la médecine, ça donne… le Centre Ingénierie Santé (CIS) !

Des dispositifs médicaux innovants (biomécanique, biomatériaux, nanoparticules) aux jumeaux numériques du patient et de l’hôpital, le CIS développe des solutions sur mesure pour répondre aux enjeux actuels de la santé.

🧠 Modélisation, simulation, intelligence collective : nos enseignants-chercheurs travaillent main dans la main avec médecins, industriels et institutions.

💙 Une seule ambition : améliorer le soin et la vie des personnes grâce à la science.

🎯 Ce que nous attendons de vous

En tant que post-doctorant(e), vous êtes au cœur des missions de recherche et d’innovation du Centre Ingénierie et Santé. Vous rejoignez l’équipe i4S pour développer les fondements scientifiques d’une nouvelle génération de jumeaux numériques populationnels (JNP) en santé, en lien étroit avec la société Dali.

Le Centre Ingénierie et Santé développe des recherches à l’interface entre ingénierie, mathématiques, informatique et santé. Ses travaux associent modélisation, simulation, intelligence artificielle et sciences des données pour répondre à des problématiques cliniques, organisationnelles et populationnelles en collaboration avec des acteurs académiques, hospitaliers et industriels.

Dali (Decision Aid · Live Innovation) est un bureau d’études innovant spécialisé dans la modélisation, la simulation et l’intelligence artificielle appliquées au système de santé. Son ambition est de transformer le système de soins grâce à une ingénierie de pointe basée sur des données : création de jumeaux numériques, modélisation prédictive, optimisation de parcours patients, modélisation de services hospitaliers et amélioration des performances des organisations de santé. Dali a été co-créée début 2025 par Martin PRODEL (PhD, 12 ans d’expérience en données de santé, ex-Heva) et Vincent Augusto (PhD, HDR, Pr, 20 d’expérience en ingénierie de la santé et recherche, Mines Saint-Etienne). 

Objectif stratégique : préparer les briques scientifiques des JNP à horizon 3 à 5 ans, au-delà des premiers démonstrateurs industriels déjà engagés.

 

Le post-doctorat doit permettre de lever des verrous en modélisation dynamique de cohortes, génération de patients virtuels, apprentissage des transitions et simulation de scénarios contrefactuels.

 

Vos missions principales :

  • Vous concevez et formalisez des modèles mathématiques et stochastiques de trajectoires de patients : chaînes de Markov, modèles multi-états, modèles d’état, processus de décision markoviens, simulation Monte-Carlo et approches hybrides.

  • Composed of alumni from: INSEAD, Berkeley, Georgetown, Bocconi, HEC Paris, Ponts et Chaussées, ESSEC, Imperial College, Dartmouth, etc.

Location: Lyon, France

Contract: Permanent (CDI)

As part of ARCHIMED's Information Systems Department (ISD), reporting directly to our Data/AI Manager, you will drive the development and deployment of Artificial Intelligence solutions across the firm. 1.       Product Development and Strategic Alignment

·       Collaborate on defining the product vision and roadmap for AI initiatives, in close alignment with firm priorities.

·       Translate & challenge business needs into clear, actionable product requirements and user stories

·       Contribute to AI governance frameworks, documentation standards and reporting to senior stakeholders

 

 

 

Profile and Qualifications

·       Education: Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Business or a related field

·       Solid understanding of AI, data pipelines and modern development methodologies  & technologies

·       Proven ability to translate complex technical concepts into business language and vice versa

·       Strong stakeholder management skills, with experience working across technical and non-technical teams

title: Senior Business Development Manager - New Business, UK & Europe
description:
About GeminiSense

GeminiSense is a collaboration between Bold Communications Ltd and Innovative Business Software (IBS), two established software businesses within the Valsoft Corporation portfolio.

The collaboration brings together the technology, experience and deep industry expertise of both organisations to deliver a next-generation, event-driven monitoring platform for the security and monitoring industry.

GeminiSense enables organisations to monitor, identify and respond to critical events in real time, bringing together alarm and incident management, CCTV and video monitoring, lone-worker protection, IoT and sensor monitoring, communications, task management and third-party integrations within a powerful, unified monitoring environment.

The platform is designed for demanding operational environments including Alarm Receiving Centres (ARCs), security monitoring centres, airports, corporate and industrial organisations, facilities management, manufacturing, local government, retail and other security-critical operations.

Backed by two Valsoft-owned software companies, GeminiSense combines deep industry knowledge with the resources and ambition to build a significant presence across the UK and European markets.

We are now looking for an exceptional Senior Business Development Manager – New Business to play a key role in accelerating that growth.

The Opportunity

This is a new-business hunter role.

We are looking for an ambitious, commercially aggressive and highly proactive Senior Business Development Manager who thrives on creating opportunities, opening doors and closing new business.

This is not an account-management role, nor is it a position for someone who expects to rely on a steady flow of inbound leads.

You will be responsible for building your own pipeline, identifying and targeting high-value prospective customers, engaging senior decision-makers and converting opportunities into new customers and recurring revenue.

You will own the complete sales process from initial prospecting and discovery through product demonstration, proposal development, commercial negotiation and contract signature.

You will have significant autonomy to develop the UK and European territory and will be expected to bring the energy, persistence and commercial discipline required to build a substantial new-business pipeline.

Your objective is simple: create pipeline, win new logos and generate new recurring revenue.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own new-business development across the UK and European markets.
  • Develop and execute a clear territory, vertical-market and target-account strategy.
  • Identify and penetrate high-value prospective customers across GeminiSense’s target markets.
  • Build and maintain a substantial qualified new-business pipeline.
  • Generate your own opportunities through proactive outbound prospecting, direct outreach, networking, referrals, partners, industry events and targeted account development.
  • Conduct consistent, high-quality prospecting into target organisations and named strategic accounts.
  • Identify multiple routes into target organisations and develop relationships with key stakeholders and influencers.
  • Engage confidently with senior decision-makers including CEOs, Managing Directors, Operations Directors, Security Directors, Control Room Managers, IT leaders and other relevant executives.
  • Conduct effective discovery to understand each prospect’s operational, security, technical and commercial challenges.
  • Translate customer requirements into compelling GeminiSense solutions with clearly defined operational and commercial benefits.
  • Position and sell the broader GeminiSense platform across alarm and incident management, CCTV/video monitoring, lone-worker protection, IoT and sensor monitoring, communications, workflow and associated monitoring applications.
  • Deliver compelling presentations, discovery sessions and product demonstrations, working with technical and product specialists where appropriate.
  • Develop strong commercial proposals, business cases and ROI justifications.
  • Own opportunities throughout the complete sales cycle, from initial contact through to contract signature.
  • Maintain momentum throughout the sales process and proactively identify and overcome obstacles to closing.
  • Develop relationships across multiple stakeholders within prospective customers to maximise the probability of successful conversion.
  • Negotiate pricing, commercial terms and contracts.
  • Consistently achieve or exceed agreed new ARR and revenue targets.
  • Maintain a disciplined, accurate and appropriately weighted sales pipeline.
  • Deliver reliable monthly and quarterly sales forecasts.
  • Develop strategic relationships with technology partners, integrators and other organisations capable of generating new opportunities.
  • Represent GeminiSense at relevant exhibitions, conferences, customer meetings and industry events throughout the UK and Europe.
  • Monitor competitors, market developments and emerging opportunities across the security and monitoring technology markets.
  • Provide structured customer and market feedback to Product, Marketing and Leadership teams.
  • Work closely with Marketing to develop targeted campaigns while remaining personally accountable for pipeline creation and new customer acquisition.

What We’re Looking For

We are looking for a proven new-business salesperson, not simply someone with sales experience.

The successful candidate will have:

  • A demonstrable track record of winning new B2B customers and exceeding sales targets.
  • Strong evidence of personally generating significant sales pipeline rather than relying predominantly on marketing-generated or inbound leads.
  • Experience selling complex B2B software, SaaS or technology solutions.
  • A history of successfully developing new territories, opening strategic accounts and winning new logos.
  • The confidence and ability to prospect consistently at senior and executive levels.
  • Excellent discovery and consultative selling capabilities.
  • Strong commercial instincts combined with a relentless focus on progressing and closing opportunities.
  • Experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder B2B sales cycles.
  • Confidence negotiating significant commercial agreements.
  • The ability to translate sophisticated technical capabilities into clear commercial and operational benefits.
  • Strong presentation, communication and negotiation skills.
  • Excellent pipeline-management and forecasting discipline.
  • High levels of personal accountability, resilience and self-motivation.
  • The ability to operate independently and effectively within a remote environment.
  • A willingness to travel throughout the UK and Europe as required.

Highly Desirable Industry Experience

Candidates with a strong track record within one or more of the following markets will be particularly attractive:

Security Technology | Alarm Monitoring | Alarm Receiving Centres (ARCs) | Security Monitoring Centres | CCTV & Video Management | PSIM | Lone-Worker Solutions | Manned Guarding Technology | IoT & Sensor Monitoring | Access Control | Smart Buildings | Critical Event Management | Incident Management Software | Physical Security Software

An established network of contacts within the security, monitoring, facilities-management or related technology sectors would be a significant advantage.

Experience selling into large enterprise customers and complex operational environments would also be highly desirable.

Additional European language skills and previous experience selling across multiple European territories would be advantageous.

The Person

We are looking for someone who is:

Competitive. Persistent. Resilient. Commercial. Accountable. Driven.

You should genuinely enjoy the challenge of opening doors that are initially closed.

An unanswered email, unsuccessful call or initial rejection should not end your pursuit of an attractive account. You will identify another stakeholder, find another route into the organisation and continue developing the opportunity.

You will be comfortable creating opportunities from a relatively cold territory and will not require a constant stream of marketing-generated leads to remain productive.

You will be highly organised and disciplined in how you manage your territory, pipeline and opportunities, while maintaining the urgency required to drive deals forward.

You will combine the persistence and determination of a true new-business hunter with the professionalism, credibility and consultative skills required to sell sophisticated technology into large and potentially mission-critical organisations.

Above all, you will have a demonstrable history of turning prospecting activity into pipeline and pipeline into revenue.

How Success Will Be Measured

This is a performance-driven sales position with clear accountability for results.

Key performance measures will include:

  • New Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) / revenue generated
  • New customers and new logos won
  • Qualified new-business pipeline created
  • Pipeline coverage against sales target
  • Target-account penetration
  • Outbound prospecting effectiveness
  • Qualified meetings and demonstrations generated
  • Opportunity creation and conversion
  • Sales-cycle progression
  • Win rates
  • Forecast accuracy
  • Achievement against quarterly and annual sales targets

The successful candidate will be expected to maintain sufficient qualified pipeline coverage to support consistent achievement of their revenue target.

Compensation

We want to attract an exceptional salesperson and recognise that compensation needs to reflect the calibre, experience and proven performance of the successful individual.

Base salary will therefore be dependent on the candidate’s experience, industry knowledge and, most importantly, their proven track record of winning new business and consistently delivering against sales targets.

In addition to base salary, the position will include a highly competitive, uncapped commission plan directly linked to new-business performance.

The commission structure will reward overachievement, with accelerators above 100% of target, ensuring that exceptional sales performance results in exceptional earnings.

There will be no cap on earning potential for a salesperson who consistently exceeds their targets.

Why GeminiSense?

This is an opportunity to join GeminiSense at an exciting stage of its development and play a significant role in building its presence across the UK and Europe.

GeminiSense combines the expertise and capabilities of Bold Communications Ltd and Innovative Business Software A/S, both part of the Valsoft Corporation portfolio.

This provides the successful candidate with the opportunity to take an innovative technology platform to market while benefiting from the experience, industry knowledge and backing of established software businesses.

This is not about simply inheriting and managing a mature sales territory.

You will have the opportunity to build one.

You will identify target markets, penetrate strategic accounts, establish new relationships, win new customers and help establish GeminiSense as a significant player within the UK and European security and monitoring technology markets.

For the right salesperson, this role offers significant autonomy, market opportunity and uncapped earning potential, alongside the opportunity to make a highly visible contribution to the growth and success of GeminiSense.

If you’re a proven new-business hunter who enjoys opening doors, creating opportunities, winning new customers and closing deals, we want to hear from you.

title: Senior Software Engineer (m/w/d) | Fullstack für KI-Produkte
description:
Über uns

Wie bleibt ein RAG-System präzise, wenn aus tausend Dokumenten hunderttausend werden? Wie orchestriert man mehrere Modellanbieter sauber hinter einer Oberfläche? Während anderswo noch Prototypen gezeigt werden, arbeiten unsere Kunden längst damit - mit ihren Daten, ihren Regeln, gehostet in Deutschland. Als Senior Engineer verantwortest du Kernfunktionen und Architektur unserer Plattform, vom Retrieval bis ins Frontend - und du entwickelst sie so, wie wir arbeiten: AI-gestützt, mit Coding-Agents als Teil des Werkzeugkastens und mit echtem Gestaltungsspielraum für deine Ideen. Du suchst eine Rolle, in der technische Tiefe und Produktverantwortung zusammenkommen? Dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen!


Das gibt es zu tun

  • Architektur & Umsetzung Du entwirfst und skalierst verteilte Systeme und Microservices - immer mit Blick auf Wartbarkeit, Stabilität und die Frage, was in zwei Jahren noch trägt. 
  • KI-Features bauen, die im Alltag halten Du entwickelst die Kernfunktionen unserer Plattform - von RAG-basierten Wissensdatenbanken über KI-Apps für einzelne Fachbereiche bis zu Voice-, Übersetzungs- und Analytics-Funktionen. 
  • Full-Stack liefern Du entwickelst performante APIs, modellierst Daten und Datenbanken und setzt moderne Oberflächen im Frontend um - vom Retrieval bis zur Benutzeroberfläche.
  • Daten, Sicherheit & Mandantenfähigkeit Du modellierst Daten für Multi-Tenancy und rollenbasierte Berechtigungen - so, dass niemand über die KI Zugriff auf etwas bekommt, das er nicht sehen darf. Verschlüsselung, Datenminimierung und Auditierbarkeit denkst du von Anfang an mit. 
  • Betrieb & Observability mitdenken Du sorgst dafür, dass Qualität, Kosten und Verhalten der KI-Features im Betrieb sichtbar bleiben - mit Evaluations, Monitoring und klaren Guardrails, damit die Plattform auch bei wachsender Nutzung stabil und effizient läuft.
  • Komplexität beherrschen Du entwickelst bestehende Systeme weiter, schaffst klare Strukturen und reduzierst technische Schulden dort, wo sie langfristig teuer werden und lässt sie stehen, wo sie es nicht sind. 
  • AI-gestützt entwickeln – und den Standard dafür setzen Du arbeitest selbstverständlich mit Coding-Assistenten und Agenten, holst mehr aus ihnen heraus als Autocomplete und weißt genau, wo ihre Grenzen liegen. Neue Tools und Workflows testest du früh, bewertest sie ehrlich und etablierst im Team, wie wir sie sinnvoll einsetzen.
  • Team & Produkt weiterbringen Du arbeitest eng mit Product Owner, UX und unseren Consultants zusammen, übersetzt echte Kunden-Use-Cases in Technik, machst technische Entscheidungen transparent und bringst unsere Junior Developer durch Code Reviews und Mentoring fachlich weiter. 


Das bringst Du mit

  • Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in der Entwicklung komplexer Softwaresysteme, idealerweise im KI- bzw. SaaS/Cloud-Umfeld
  • Sehr gute TypeScript-Kenntnisse, Erfahrung mit Node.js und idealerweise Frameworks wie NestJS 
  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Softwarearchitektur für verteilte Systeme - Microservices, API-Design, Skalierung 
  • Erfahrung im Frontend, z. B. mit Vue.js, sowie ein gutes Verständnis für Full-Stack-Zusammenhänge 
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse im Umgang mit Datenbanken (z. B. PostgreSQL), Datenmodellierung und Performance-Optimierung 
  • Erfahrung mit Cloud-Plattformen (z. B. AWS), Docker und dem Betrieb von SaaS-Anwendungen 
  • AI-gestütztes Entwickeln ist für dich Alltag: Du arbeitest routiniert mit Coding-Assistenten und -Agenten (z. B. Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot), kennst ihre Grenzen und prüfst generierten Code kritisch, statt ihm zu vertrauen 
  • Du bist nah am Puls der Entwicklung: Du probierst neue Tools, Modelle und Workflows aktiv aus und bringst die guten ins Team - Erfahrung mit agentischen Setups (z. B. Coding-Agents in der Cloud, MCP-Integrationen, automatisierte Reviews) ist ein starkes Plus 
  • Tieferes Verständnis moderner AI-/LLM-Konzepte wie RAG, Function Calling, Embeddings oder Agenten
  • Clean Code, Testing und Code Reviews sind für dich selbstverständlich und du bringst Junior Developers durch Reviews und Mentoring gern fachlich weiter 
  • Du triffst technische Entscheidungen und kannst sie nachvollziehbar vertreten - auf Deutsch und auf Englisch 
  • Erfahrung mit DSGVO, ISO 27001 oder dem EU AI Act sind ein Plus 

Was uns wichtig ist 
Frameworks kann man lernen. Was uns viel wichtiger ist: Verantwortung übernehmen, das Produkt mitdenken, Anforderungen konstruktiv hinterfragen und technische Entscheidungen treffen, die man auch in zwei Jahren noch begründen kann - pragmatisch abgewogen zwischen Perfektion und Geschwindigkeit. Konkret heißt das: Du entwirfst morgens die Architektur für ein neues Feature, reviewst mittags Pull Requests, entwickelst nachmittags selbst und bringst dabei unser Team fachlich weiter. Wer lieber Tickets abarbeitet und auf Anforderungen wartet, wird bei uns nicht glücklich.


Das bekommst Du

  • Start & Welcoming so wie du es verdienst! Ein strukturiertes Onboarding mit echten Ansprechpersonen - damit du vom ersten Tag an durchstartest.
  • Remote Work Homeoffice innerhalb von Deutschland oder Arbeiten in unserem modernen Büro in Offenburg? Arbeite so, wie es für dich am besten passt.

Transformation ist für uns kein Trend, sondern unser Auftrag: Seit 1995 begleitet die avenit Group Unternehmen dabei, sich für die digitale Zukunft neu aufzustellen - ganzheitlich, strategisch und mit klarem Blick für nachhaltige Erfolge. Folgende Aufgaben erwarten dich bei uns

  • Sorge dafür, dass wir die richtigen Dinge messen: Gemeinsam mit Produkt, Redaktion und Engineering entwickelst Du Tracking- und Messkonzepte, definierst relevante Kennzahlen und stellst sicher, dass die benötigten Daten vollständig, verständlich und verlässlich zur Verfügung stehen. Dabei bewegst Du Dich sicher an der Schnittstelle zur technischen Datenerhebung und arbeitest auch selbst mit SQL und strukturierten Datensätzen.
  • Mach Daten für Teams zugänglich und nutzbar: Du entwickelst Dashboards, Reports und Analysen, mit denen Teams Erfolge transparent messen, Entwicklungen früh erkennen und unsere Zielgruppen respektvoll und differenziert verstehen können. Als analytischer Sparringspartner berätst Du Redaktions- und Produktteams dabei, aus Daten konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen abzuleiten.
  • Mach aus Nutzungsmustern echte Erkenntnisse: Du analysierst, wie Menschen die digitalen Inhalte und Produkte der ARD nutzen, und übersetzt komplexe Analytics- und Trackingdaten in verständliche und handlungsleitende Erkenntnisse. Damit hilfst Du Produkt- und Redaktionsteams, fundierte Entscheidungen zu treffen und digitale Angebote kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln.


Das bringst du mit

  • Idealerweise ein abgeschlossenes Studium mit quantitativem oder analytischem Schwerpunkt, z. B. in Wirtschaftsinformatik, Statistik, Mathematik, Sozial- oder Wirtschaftswissenschaften, oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
  • Erfahrung in der Analyse und Aufbereitung großer Datenmengen sowie im Umgang mit digitalen Nutzungs- und Trackingdaten

title: Product Owner | Full Time (m/w/d)
description:
Who Are We ?

🚧 Picture logistics that run like clockwork — fast, smart, and seamless.

Autonomous logistics does not start with self-driving trucks. It starts with CONROO.

At CONROO, we are building an intelligent infrastructure that drives terminals and depots towards autonomy by connecting truck drivers, terminals, and depots through continuous data flows. We replace manual and paper-based processes with real-time, data-driven workflows, turning chaos into connected systems and making truck handling fully digital.

Every step we automate today lays the foundation for terminals and depots to operate autonomously tomorrow.

We are CONROO and we are driving logistics to autonomy.

Tasks

As a Product Owner at CONROO, you'll be one of the people steering where our product goes next. You'll spend time with customers and stakeholders to really understand what they need, then turn that into requirements the team can actually build from. You'll work closely with our developers day to day, answering questions, and making calls when priorities need to shift. It's a role with real ownership in the sense that what you decide matters, and you'll see it show up in the product.

🎖 What Success Looks Like

In your first month

  • You become familiar with the company, product, development process, customers, and key business areas and projects.
  • You work closely with Tech, Sales, and other teams to understand customer needs, business objectives, and product priorities.
  • You join Scrum ceremonies and observe how requirements and priorities are managed.
  • You align and guide a cross-functional team. Setting clear priorities, offering direction, and helping people do their best work.

By 3 months

  • You analyse and manage project requirements and stakeholder demands.
  • You independently create, prioritize, and maintain the product backlog based on customer needs and business objectives.
  • You take ownership of user stories, acceptance criteria, and product requirements.
  • You take an active role in Scrum management and coordination.
  • You ensure our product meets UX standards, quality standards, and relevant regulatory requirements.
  • You will communicate product vision, goals, priorities, and progress to internal and external stakeholders.
  • You communicate directly with customers and stakeholders to understand their needs and translate them into actionable requirements.
  • You will have full ownership of assigned projects and topics and manage them with increasing autonomy.

By 6 months

  • You independently manage projects and requirements from initial stage through implementation.
  • You have full ownership of Scrum processes and ensure effective collaboration and communication across teams.
  • You proactively identify customer needs, product opportunities, risks, and areas for improvement.
  • You contribute significantly to product development and prioritisation.
  • You consistently improve project management, requirements management, and quality processes where needed.
  • You operate autonomously while keeping relevant stakeholders aligned and informed.
  • You become the trusted point of contact for product-related topics across Tech, Sales, and other teams.

Requirements

🚀 What You Need to Be Successful

  • You bring 5+ years of experience as a Product Owner in a SaaS environment.
  • You are a native German speaker and fluent in English.
  • You have experience working with SCRUM and agile development processes.
  • You have experience in specifying requirements and developing user and technical stories.
  • You possess a solid understanding of technology, software development, and digital products.
  • You quickly grasp complex processes & technical requirements allowing you to create tailored solutions that deliver value for both clients and the business.
  • You bring strong communication skills and are confident working with a wide range of stakeholders, from C-level executives and internal teams to customers.
  • You bring strong organizational skills and are comfortable managing and prioritizing multiple requirements.
  • You are based in Nuremberg, Munich, or the surrounding area and are able to work from our Nuremberg or Munich office at least three days per week.

⚙️ Must Have Tools & Technologies

  • You have experience working with Jira or similar project management tools.
  • You are familiar with Figma or similar design and collaboration tools.
  • You have experience working with CRM systems.

💡It’s a Plus If You Have

  • Previous experience in the logistics industry.
  • Experience working in a startup or scale-up environment.

🌱 How We Set You Up to Be Successful

At CONROO, we don’t just define what success looks like — we actively support you in getting there through a structured, hands-on onboarding process during your first six months with us.

  • Onboarding sessions with your manager and our Head of Product and Engineering Alex, to understand your role, goals, and priorities.
  • Onboarding sessions with our COO, Ksenia and CEO, Felix, to learn about CONROO’s vision, strategy, and business.
  • HR onboarding with our People Partner, Hind, covering our values, tools, policies, and processes.
  • Product onboarding with our Product Owner, Özgür.
  • A buddy system during your first two months to help you onboard smoothly, get up to speed, and have a go-to person for questions.
  • Clear goals for your first 1, 3, and 5 months, with expectations defined from day one so you know how success is measured.
  • We know that starting a new role can be overwhelming. That’s why we provide clear documentation, a structured to-do list, and role-specific materials to help you get up to speed quickly.

Benefits

🌱About Our Team

We’re a team of around 30 curious minds working from our offices in Munich and Nuremberg — and remotely across Germany. We value ownership and a mindset driven by continuous learning. We take ideas seriously, see them through, and aren’t afraid to roll up our sleeves when challenges arise. As we grow, we keep raising the bar, looking for smarter, better ways to work — and have fun in the process together along the way.

🤝Why Us

💫 A mission that matters: Be part of a company that’s working on something meaningful and a purpose you can stand behind.

🏝️ Workation: Switch up your usual scenery and spend up to 30 days working remotely from a different location.

👊 Witness your actions shape our direction: You’re given the ownership and trust to make decisions that matter and the results are visible.

🏔️ Company getaway: Two annual team getaways where we work, unwind, and connect — away from the office. We went to the Austrian Alps last year, where should we go next?

🏢 Multiple office locations: Join us in one of our vibrant offices in Munich, Nuremberg, or Duisburg.

🎟️ Employee discounts: Use our employee discount portal to access attractive deals from top brands across tech, travel, fashion, home, and more — online and in-store.

🌍 International team: With 10 nationalities across a team of around 30 people, you’ll be part of a naturally diverse environment where different perspectives come together.

🧠 Hungry for knowledge? Our monthly S.H.A.R.E sessions teach you something new every month and give you the stage to share your passion & expertise too. If you want to go further, we’re happy to support you with a course, workshop, or other training opportunities.

Our Recruitment Process - simple, quick, and human.

  1. Application review
  2. Introduce yourself in a 30-minute call with our People Partner, Hind
  3. Deep dive into your experience in a 45-minute interview with our Head of Product & Engineering, Alex.
  4. Raise the bar in a case study and a 60-minute interview with our COO, Ksenia, and CEO, Felix, in our Munich office.

💪 Join us and shape the future of logistics.

title: Senior/Staff Platform Engineer (m/f/x)
description:
Your Role

We ship fast, and we intend to keep shipping fast. The consequence is that our system is outgrowing the amount of deliberate design that went into it. We run AI agents over customer documents in a domain where being wrong is expensive, and a lot of the load-bearing decisions about how those fit together are still implicit.

You will be making those decisions explicit and then making them hold. That means codifying golden paths, building the shared primitives and APIs that product engineers work on top of, owning the architecture of the system as a whole, and establishing what our reliability actually needs to be before an incident establishes it for us.

Platform at Cortea sits between software engineering, DevOps and SRE. Its customers are other engineers. This is not a DevOps role under a different name: you will spend more time in application code than in YAML, and the reason we want infrastructure experience is that we don't believe you can design a system well without being able to run it.

The bar we are hiring against is someone who has taken a system from nothing to production and owned it end to end. You picked the technology, argued the tradeoffs in writing, provisioned the infrastructure, and were responsible for it when it broke.


On AI

We use AI heavily and we want you to. What we are not looking for is someone who outsources their judgment to it.

The mental model of this system has to live in your head, not in a context window. Use agents to move quickly on implementation. Do the design, the reasoning and the writing yourself, and be able to defend every decision you ship.


What you'll do

Four areas, roughly in the order you will spend time on them. You won't work on all of them at once, but you should be open to any of them.

Product platform. Make the easiest way for product engineers to do something (the paved road, or golden path) also the most secure, reliable and scalable way by default. Build the shared primitives, libraries and APIs that hide complexity and carry our quality and observability standards with them. Own the architecture and the core stack: what gets standardized, what gets reused, and where the system should be in eighteen months.

Infrastructure, observability and reliability. Infrastructure as code by default, from cloud resources through to dashboards and alerts. Provision, run and tune our Kubernetes cluster and cloud footprint, and keep CI fast as the deploy rate grows. Define SLIs for the workloads that
matter, build SLOs on top of them, and make the alerting high-signal enough that people trust it. Drive down AI and infrastructure spend.

Security and compliance. Keep the internal foundations secure by default: IAM, dependency management, secrets. Own the authentication and authorization stack, including ReBAC models covering both humans and agents. Implement SOC 2 and ISO 27001 controls without taxing every future change.

AI dev tooling. Keep product engineers and their agents on the paved road by making sure the documentation and agent guidelines they need are in place. Shorten the path from design to implementation with standardized automations and development environments that stay close to production.


What this looks like in practice

  • A system of record for managing and distributing constantly evolving agent configurations, under strict auditability and tenant isolation requirements

  • The harnesses powering our AI agents, abstracting over use cases that change faster than the code

  • Centralized progress tracking that holds up across a growing number of parallel agent executions

  • Usage-based tenant billing with quotas and rate limiting across a growing set of products

  • SLIs for the background job system behind our agents (execution latency, AI spend, memory, CPU), then fixing the bottlenecks they expose at both the application and infrastructure level

  • A document pipeline handling dozens of file formats, very large spreadsheets and hundreds of parallel uploads, under a strong reliability requirement


You will fit into this role if you…

  • Have designed, built and operated distributed systems end to end, and enjoy understanding how every part interacts with the rest

  • Are strong at backend software engineering and at DevOps/SRE, and don't think of those as separate jobs

  • Write design docs, RFCs, ADRs, postmortems

  • Reach for simple, boring solutions first, can tell essential complexity from accidental, and know which corners are safe to cut and which ones compound

  • Can turn a hard problem on its head and find the alternative nobody proposed

Concretely, you have scaled Postgres or another relational transactional database under real load, run production Kubernetes, and built observability rather than inherited it: SLIs, SLOs, distributed tracing.

No one checks every box. If you have designed a system from scratch, run it in production, and can explain in writing why it is shaped the way it is, let's talk.


Nice-to-haves that are a plus:

  • Durable workflow orchestrators like Temporal, and background job and queue processing generally

  • Infrastructure for LLM-based products or agentic systems

  • Audit, finance, compliance, or another high-accuracy domain

  • Azure and/or GCP


This is probably not the right role if…

  • You would describe application code as someone else's responsibility. A large share of platform work here happens inside the product codebase.

  • Your answer to reliability is more process. We want guardrails, not gates.

  • You need a well-defined system to work in. Ours is not one yet, and shaping it is the job.


What you will get

  • You own the brand and shape how the product feels. Work face-to-face with experienced founders and learn directly from customer insights.

  • Real influence on strategy. In a small team of excellent engineers and operators with high autonomy, you will shape product direction. Best idea wins, regardless of seniority.

  • Fast, ambitious, and fun team. Decisions get made in hours, not weeks. Rapid experimentation is the default.

  • Meaningful equity and competitive salary. You are one of the first to build this, and you share in the upside.

  • A mission that matters. Building intelligent systems for a $200bn industry. From Berlin, with AI at the core.

  • Second Call — Technical interview with Dan

  • Third Call — Deep dive into our culture with our Co-Founder Philipp

description:

Who we’re looking for

Craft is the baseline here, not a nice-to-have. What sets you apart is range and judgment: you know what good looks like, you know when something looks right but feels wrong, and you can get a team there with you.

Your role

As Growth Marketing Manager – Automation you own the automated systems that carry a user from first signup through activation to expansion – and the CRM and AI infrastructure underneath them. Our growth model is self-service and low-touch by design. That only works if the machine behind it is genuinely good.

HubSpot sits at the centre of that machine, connected to product usage data, billing and our web and trial funnel. Your job is to make it do more, do it automatically, and do it with AI agents built natively into the flow – not bolted on as an afterthought.

We are deliberately open on the shape of this role. There are two ways to be excellent at it, and we will build the role around whichever one you bring.

What you will do – the core

  • Own our marketing and sales automation stack, with HubSpot (Marketing + Sales Hub) at the centre and clean connections to product, billing, website and trial funnel.
  • Design, build and continuously improve automated journeys across the whole lifecycle: trial onboarding, activation nudges, lead scoring and routing, upsell and cross-sell, win-back and churn prevention.
  • Replace manual processes with automation – every recurring task a human does today is a candidate, in marketing and in sales.
  • Build AI agents into the funnel natively: qualification, enrichment, routing, response drafting, content generation. Not just AI features inside HubSpot.
  • Keep our data trustworthy: lifecycle stages, attribution and product-usage signals flowing reliably between systems.
  • Measure what you build – every journey has a metric, a baseline and an iteration plan.
  • Work closely with Sales, Product, Growth Analytics and eCommerce, and make their work easier by removing manual steps from it.

Two possible focus areas – pick yours

You should be strong in one of these and comfortable in the other. Tell us in your application which one is yours.

Focus A – Technical / AI Automation

  • You architect HubSpot rather than just operate it: data model, custom objects and properties, APIs, webhooks, integrations.
  • You build automations beyond HubSpot too – with workflow tools (n8n, Make, Zapier) and with LLM and agent frameworks.
  • You are comfortable with APIs, JSON and enough Python or JavaScript to ship something yourself instead of queueing behind engineering.
  • You have already built working agentic automations, not just prototyped with a chat interface.

Focus B – Lifecycle & Content Automation

  • You own the content inside the journeys: onboarding series, activation emails, in-product messaging, nurture and reactivation tracks.
  • You write German copy that sounds like a person wrote it, not a workflow – and you use AI to produce more of it, faster, without losing that.
  • You design journeys around real user behaviour and know which message at which moment actually moves the metric.
  • You are relentless about testing subject lines, timing, triggers and sequencing.

  • Deep, hands-on HubSpot experience: workflows, custom properties and objects, lists, lifecycle stages, reporting. You know where its limits are and how to work around them.
  • Clear strength in one of the two focus areas above and solid working knowledge of the other.
  • Genuine curiosity about AI agents and automation – you have already built things with LLMs, not only read about them.
  • Analytical and structured, with a low tolerance for manual, repetitive processes.
  • Fluent German and English. Our customers are German SMBs and much of the journey content is in German.
  • Self-starter who can carry several topics in parallel and finish them.

Optional - nice to have

Werde Teil unseres Operations-Teams

Nutze die Chance, Teil unseres wachsenden Teams bei der Homery Living GmbH in Vörstetten zu werden und deine Karriere im strukturierten Umfeld des Unterkunftsmanagements zu gestalten.

Wir suchen neue Mitarbeiter für unser Operations-Team, die uns dabei unterstützen, das Buchungs- und Unterkunftsmanagement unserer Standorte zu steuern, mit Firmenkunden und Gästen zu kommunizieren und einen reibungslosen Ablauf von der Buchungsanfrage bis zur Abreise sicherzustellen.

Wenn du kommunikativ und redegewandt bist, gerne mit Kunden und Gästen arbeitest und gleichzeitig Wert auf klare Prozesse und strukturierte Arbeitsabläufe legst, bist du bei uns genau richtig.

Über Homery Living GmbH

Die Homery Living GmbH mit Sitz in Vörstetten ist spezialisiert auf das Management und die operative Verwaltung von Monteurunterkünften. Wir bieten umfangreiche Dienstleistungen im Bereich Buchungs- und Unterkunftsmanagement an und zeichnen uns durch klare Prozesse und Strukturen aus.

Unser Ansatz ist es, alle operativen Abläufe direkt vom Büro aus zu steuern. Dazu gehören die Gästekommunikation, die Zusammenarbeit mit Firmenkunden sowie die Organisation der Buchungen, Preisgestaltung, Rechnungsstellung, Kalenderverwaltung, Reinigungskoordination und Problemlösung.

Die Homery Living GmbH verwaltet derzeit über 1.000 Betten an verschiedenen Standorten in Deutschland und gewährleistet durch bewährte Methoden, dokumentierte Prozesse und klare Strukturen stabile und zuverlässige Dienstleistungen.

Unser Unternehmen steht für Qualität, professionelle Abwicklung und den Anspruch, sowohl für unsere Kunden als auch für unsere Mitarbeiter langfristig verlässliche Strukturen zu schaffen.

Aufgaben

Deine Aufgaben

Du steuerst gemeinsam mit unserem Operations-Team die täglichen Abläufe rund um unsere Monteurunterkünfte. Deine Arbeit findet dabei überwiegend digital und telefonisch von unserem Büro in Vörstetten aus statt.

Zu deinen Aufgaben gehören insbesondere:

  • Bearbeitung und Koordination von Buchungsanfragen
  • Telefonische und schriftliche Kommunikation mit Firmenkunden und Gästen
  • Erstellung und Versand von Angeboten und Rechnungen
  • Preisverhandlungen mit Kunden
  • Verwaltung und Pflege unserer Buchungskalender
  • Koordination von Reinigungen und weiteren operativen Abläufen
  • Bearbeitung und Lösung auftretender Probleme während eines Aufenthalts
  • Abstimmung mit unserem internen Team sowie externen Dienstleistern
  • Sicherstellung eines strukturierten Ablaufs von der Buchungsanfrage bis zur Abreise

Qualifikation

Welcher berufliche Hintergrund zu uns passt

Besonders gut passt diese Position zu dir, wenn du bereits Erfahrung in der Hotellerie, im Reservierungsmanagement oder in der Gästebetreuung gesammelt hast.

Geeignete berufliche Hintergründe sind beispielsweise:

  • Hotelfachfrau / Hotelfachmann
  • Kaufmann / Kauffrau für Hotelmanagement
  • Reservierungsmitarbeiter / Reservierungsmitarbeiterin
  • Reservation Agent
  • Front Office Agent
  • Front Office Manager
  • Rezeptionist / Rezeptionistin
  • Empfangsmitarbeiter / Empfangsmitarbeiterin im Hotel
  • Guest Service Agent
  • Mitarbeiter / Mitarbeiterin im Reservierungs- oder Buchungsmanagement

Dabei handelt es sich bei uns nicht um eine klassische Tätigkeit an einer Hotelrezeption. Die operative Betreuung unserer Unterkünfte wird zentral aus unserem Büro gesteuert. Der Kontakt zu Kunden und Gästen erfolgt hauptsächlich telefonisch sowie per E-Mail und WhatsApp.

Auch Quereinsteiger mit einem passenden beruflichen Hintergrund und den entsprechenden persönlichen Voraussetzungen können sich bei uns bewerben.

Das solltest du mitbringen

  • Du bist kommunikativ, überzeugungsstark und redegewandt.
  • Du hast Freude am professionellen Umgang mit Gästen und Firmenkunden.
  • Du kannst bestehenden Prozessen zuverlässig folgen und arbeitest gerne innerhalb klar definierter Abläufe.
  • Du besitzt eine schnelle Auffassungsgabe.
  • Du arbeitest diszipliniert, zuverlässig und sorgfältig.
  • Du verfügst über starke kommunikative Fähigkeiten.
  • Du verfügst über eine saubere und fehlerfreie schriftliche Ausdrucksform in deutscher Sprache.
  • Du kannst auch bei mehreren gleichzeitig anfallenden Aufgaben strukturiert arbeiten und den Überblick behalten.

Benefits

Das erwartet dich bei uns

  • Strukturierte Arbeitsumgebung: Eine durchorganisierte Arbeitsweise für eine effektive und zielorientierte Tätigkeit.
  • Dokumentierte Arbeitsprozesse: Klar nachvollziehbare Abläufe für effiziente und fehlerfreie Arbeitsschritte.
  • Sicherer und langfristiger Arbeitsplatz: Wir möchten gemeinsam mit unseren Mitarbeitern langfristig wachsen. Das Ziel jeder Einstellung ist eine dauerhafte und unbefristete Zusammenarbeit.
  • Leistungsbasierte Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten: Bei entsprechender Leistung und persönlicher Entwicklung bestehen klare Möglichkeiten, innerhalb des Unternehmens zusätzliche Verantwortung zu übernehmen und sich beruflich weiterzuentwickeln.
  • Kontinuierliche Weiterbildung: Regelmäßige Möglichkeiten zur Erweiterung deiner fachlichen Kenntnisse und Fähigkeiten.
  • Positives und kollegiales Arbeitsumfeld: Uns ist wichtig, dass wir gerne miteinander arbeiten, uns gegenseitig unterstützen und gemeinsam an unseren Zielen arbeiten. Wir ziehen an einem Strang, motivieren uns gegenseitig zu guten Leistungen und schaffen ein Umfeld, in dem persönliche und berufliche Weiterentwicklung möglich ist.
  • Attraktive Vergütung: Für die Position ist ein Bruttogehalt von 3.500 € monatlich vorgesehen.

Unser Büro am Standort Vörstetten

Am Standort Vörstetten erwartet dich auf einer Bürofläche von 140 Quadratmetern ein modernes Arbeitsumfeld. Ausgestattet mit elektrisch höhenverstellbaren Schreibtischen und modernen Arbeitsgeräten, unterstützt unser Büro optimal deine Arbeitsabläufe.

Das Bürogebäude bietet durch Klimaanlage, Fußbodenheizung und Raumbelüftung eine angenehme und ruhige Arbeitsatmosphäre. Stellplätze direkt vor unserem Bürogebäude machen das Parken einfach und bequem.

Das neu entwickelte Industriegebiet, in dem sich unser Standort befindet, zeichnet sich durch seine ruhige Lage und eine gute Busanbindung aus, die dir eine unkomplizierte Anreise ermöglicht.

Deine Einarbeitung & unsere digitale Schulungsplattform

Für deine Einarbeitung planen wir je nach Vorerfahrung etwa 4 bis 8 Wochen ein.

Du erhältst direkt zum Start Zugriff auf unsere digitale Schulungsplattform, die dir alle notwendigen Inhalte für deine neue Tätigkeit bereitstellt. Die Einarbeitung wird durch die Leitung Operations koordiniert, damit du von Anfang an gezielt in alle relevanten Abläufe eingeführt wirst.

Der erste Teil der Einarbeitung wird persönlich durchgeführt. Ergänzend stehen dir Schulungsvideos, schriftliche Anleitungen und dokumentierte Prozesse zur Verfügung, die deine Aufgaben Schritt für Schritt erklären.

Dadurch weißt du nicht nur, was zu tun ist, sondern kannst bei Fragen jederzeit auf bestehende Abläufe und Anleitungen zurückgreifen. Auch Quereinsteiger können dadurch systematisch in ihre neue Tätigkeit eingearbeitet werden.

Die wichtigsten Eckdaten

Position: Mitarbeiter Operations / Buchungs- & Unterkunftsmanagement (m/w/d)
Arbeitsort: Vörstetten
Beschäftigungsart: Vollzeit
Vergütung: 3.500 € brutto pro Monat
Einarbeitungszeit: ca. 4–8 Wochen
Perspektive: Langfristige Zusammenarbeit mit dem Ziel einer unbefristeten Beschäftigung
