title: Product Manager (parental leave cover)
description:
About Tandem

Tandem is the leading global language learning community, with over 35 million members from all around the world practicing languages together. The concept of learning from each other is not only core to the Tandem community, it is also at the heart of how we work every day at Tandem.


We are based in Berlin, profitable and growing, and backed by top European investors. We are highly international and driven by a shared passion for languages, technology, and culture. Together, we are on a mission to connect the world through languages, by building a product that helps people not just learn, but truly understand each other across cultures.


We are looking for a bright, data-driven, collaborative operator to help us improve the experience of our members. 


Your role will be to:

  • Run the experiment loop: hypothesis, spec, launch, readout, ship or kill. Keep a steady cadence of live tests.

  • Find the next bets from data, research, and member feedback - not from a backlog of random ideas.

  • Spec and land a small number of features with design and engineering; you are accountable for the outcome, not the ticket.

  • Share results in a way the rest of Tandem can act on.


You are the right fit for the role if you:

  • Have 3+ years of product management experience, including consumer mobile apps at scale.

  • Are analytical: you know the metrics that matter, can reason about experiments and statistical results, and are fluent in product analytics.

  • Have a proactive, independent way of working, with leadership and ownership you can point to - not only ideas, but things you shipped.

  • Are a clear communicator and a strong collaborator, with excellent written and spoken English.

  • Care about simple, intuitive user experiences and can work closely with design to get there.

  • Like hard problems and stay with them until they are solved.

  • Use AI in your own work to move faster, and are thoughtful about where it belongs in product operations.


The benefits


Passion for languages: 

We’re a team of 30 people speaking 20 languages fluently between us. For those wanting to improve their German (or Denglisch!), you can join one of our German classes on us.


Take a deep dive: 

As a Tandem team member, we’ll give you a budget for up to 6 “Deep Dive Days” per year. Pick a topic you’ve always wanted to explore for your professional development that has never made it out of your backlog. Then book a cabin in the woods or whatever matches your individual learning style.


Teams who train together, stay together: 

We offer Urban Sports Club gym memberships to boost our team’s physical and mental health. If you prefer, we can contribute to your monthly public transport ticket instead.


It takes a team to Tandem: 

Bonding with our teammates outside of our normal work routine is important to us. We organize regular team events: from day trips to monthly lunches, summer BBQs, and movie nights.


Balance matters: 

Life isn’t just about work. We know when to snooze Slack notifications, recharge our batteries, and take time out for our personal hobbies. As home office has become the new normal for some of us, it’s even more important to be able to switch off from work and relax.


Modern family: 

As part of our family-friendly company philosophy, we embrace flexible working hours, welcome families to our events, and love for our kids to visit the office and get a taste of life at Tandem.


Relocation without the stress: 

If you’re looking to relocate to Berlin, we’re ready to assist you with the infamous German bureaucracy. Many of us have been through it before, so we have plenty of tips to share. You’ll feel settled in no time.


Hybrid by design: 

We’re all about embracing a flexible, modern way of working. That’s why we focus on a hybrid approach—balancing time between our vibrant Berlin-Mitte office and the comfort of your home. It’s the best of both worlds, and we’ll support you in creating the perfect setup for this dynamic way of working.

title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer / SRE – Kubernetes & Hybrid Cloud (m/f/d)
description:
Introduction

At a glance 

  • Location & work model: Berlin, hybrid
  • Tech stack: Kubernetes on our own servers, Harvester (KubeVirt), Argo CD/Flux, Prometheus/Grafana, Longhorn/Ceph
  • Team: A growing SRE team – you report to our CTPO for now and to the Team Lead SRE we're hiring next; two system administrators in Pforzheim run the physical hardware
  • Process: Intro call · take-home task (~2h) · 90-min tech interview with our developers · leadership conversation · meet the team
  • Languages: Fluent English required; German is a plus, not a must

Why this role is special 

Most SRE jobs today mean clicking around a managed cloud console. This one doesn't. We run our own hardware in Frankfurt and are building a modern private cloud platform on Kubernetes and Harvester – on-prem by default, with elastic burst into the public cloud and the option to go cloud-only later. You won't inherit a finished SRE practice: you'll help define it, side by side with our Berlin development teams – and you won't do it alone, a Team Lead SRE hire is coming next. 

SRE here is an enabling discipline: you build what our developers need to ship reliably, while two system administrators in Pforzheim run the physical hardware. And the impact is direct – our product discovery technology powers more than 2,000 European online shops (Intersport, SPAR, Douglas and more), handling billions of shopper queries a year. When product discovery is slow or down, our customers lose revenue in real time. 

Your first 90 days 

You get to know both products, join the on-call rotation with a buddy, and own your first reliability topic – SLOs for one product, alerting that actually helps at 3 a.m., or automating away a piece of toil. By day 90 you've shipped visible improvements and know where you want to take the platform next.


Your mission

  • Define and own SLOs, SLIs and error budgets; drive data-informed reliability decisions
  • Lead incident response end-to-end: fast detection, clear communication, blameless postmortems – and reduce whole classes of incidents structurally, not case by case
  • Eliminate toil through automation and GitOps; evolve our observability (metrics, logs, traces, alerting, runbooks) across two different stacks
  • Help build our custom Kubernetes operator (CRDs) that makes stateful search clusters declarative, self-healing and safely upgradable – and roll out the auto-scaling (HPA/VPA, KEDA, cluster auto scaler) today's architecture makes hard
  • Plan capacity, performance  and cost across on-premises and cloud – including the large-catalogue and peak-season loads our merchants care about – and use AI tools wherever they measurably speed up diagnosis and operations


Your profile

Must-haves: 

  • Kubernetes in production – built, not just used: you've set up and maintained clusters on your own servers (e.g. kubeadm, RKE2, k3s) and know cluster lifecycle and upgrades – managed-only experience isn't enough for this role
  • Lived SRE practice: SLOs, error budgets, incident management, on-call
  • Hands-on experience with GitOpsor comparable infrastructure/deployment automation – experience with Argo CD or Flux is a strong plus
  • Solid observability skills – metrics, logs, traces, alerting that people trust
  • A strong automation instinct – you'd rather fix a problem's cause than repeat its workaround
  • A collaborative, enabling mindset – you see SRE as a service to our developers: you ask what they need, discuss trade-offs openly, and don't fall in love with your own solution
Nice-to-haves (genuinely optional – we'll teach you the rest): 
  • Harvester, KubeVirt, vSphere/ESXi, OpenStack or similar virtualization/HCI platforms
  • Container storage (Longhorn, Ceph) and datacenter networking (load balancing, ingress, VLAN)
  • Auto-scaling (HPA, VPA, KEDA, cluster auto scaler) and capacity/cost planning
  • Experience building Kubernetes operators/CRDs
  • German language skills
Certifications (CKA, CKS) are welcome but no substitute for hands-on experience – in the tech interview we'll ask about what you've actually built and operated. 

You don't tick every box – or your title was never “SRE”? Apply anyway. If you've owned production systems, handled incidents and worked deeply with Kubernetes, we want to hear from you – production experience and engineering mindset matter more to us than titles or buzzwords.


THE JOY OF WORKING WITH US

  • Impact from day one: Your work directly influences the revenue of leading eCommerce brands across Europe.
  • Modern tech stack: Kubernetes, Harvester, GitOps, auto-scaling, and an exciting path toward the cloud – with room to build things right.
  • AI-first mindset: We use AI as a real part of our daily work, not as a buzzword.
  • Ownership & growth: Clear responsibility, short decision paths, and the opportunity to actively shape your role.
  • Flexible work: Hybrid work model three office days per week with a focus on outcomes.
  • Strong team: Experienced engineers, an open feedback culture, and an environment where reliability is treated as a real engineering discipline.


Job Location

Berlin, Munich, Pforzheim or Stockholm (all Hybrid)

Du übernimmst Deine Kunden ab Vertragsunterschrift von Sales und begleitest sie über den gesamten Customer Lifecycle. Unser Service Desk übernimmt operative Tickets und Nutzungsfragen. So kannst Du Dich voll auf die strategische und kommerzielle Entwicklung Deiner Accounts konzentrieren.

Adsquare's mission is centered on:

  • Passion: Solving complex challenges with exceptional people, technology, and data.

  • Niche: Specializing in Location Intelligence for Programmatic Advertisers.


Our work is guided by our core values, and we look for candidates who embody them:

  • Drive: Turning ambition into action that brings valuable outcomes.

  • No BS: Upholding honesty, transparency, and clear communication.

  • Humble: Valuing modesty and letting results speak for themselves.

  • Moral Compass: Acting with fairness, integrity, and respect.


About the team

You'll join Adsquare's Data Products team, responsible for the pipelines and signals that power our Location Intelligence solutions. Working closely with our Lead PM for Data Products and a squad of data engineers, you'll help ingest, process, and scale the supplier and panel data that fuels our products. Your squad sits at the intersection of engineering, data governance, and downstream teams like Measurement and Activation, ensuring the signals we deliver are fast, reliable, and trustworthy.


Your Mission

As Product Owner for SDV Data Products (f/m/d), you'll own your squad's delivery, turning strategy into clear, testable backlog items while managing the technical scale of our core data pipelines. You'll be the primary technical counterpart to our data suppliers and panel partners, driving the operational reliability that keeps our signals fresh and trusted.


Your Profile

  • 3-5 years of experience as a Product Owner or technical PM, ideally in AdTech, MarTech, or another data-heavy ecosystem.

  • Strong at managing delivery and technical scale: sequencing complex backend work, mapping dependencies, and scoping against time, whether working with engineers, architects, or integration teams.

  • Operationally rigorous: comfortable thinking in SLIs, SLOs, freshness, match rate, and MTTR, not just features shipped, and skilled at running a tight, testable backlog.

  • Data-fluent, with required SQL proficiency: able to independently query internal data sources to investigate supplier data, panel quality, and pipeline KPIs, and bring quantified evidence into prioritisation.

  • Comfortable with ambiguity: able to make decisions with limited information and translate business intent clearly for engineering.

  • A privacy-aware product thinker who understands data governance and how evolving privacy frameworks affect upstream ingestion and pipeline logic.

  • A clear communicator across altitudes, able to translate strategy into specs and engineering reality into product trade-offs.

  • A true owner who drives outcomes without step-by-step direction and surfaces tensions upward rather than resolving them quietly.


What you will do

  • Own and maintain your squad's backlog, working closely with the Lead PM for Data Products to translate strategy into clear, testable user stories.

  • Lead the roadmap for modernising, scaling, and optimising our core data ingestion and processing pipelines to handle high-throughput workloads.

title: Staff Mobile Engineer - Retail
description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

As a Staff Mobile Engineer in Global Retail, you'll shape how customers discover, browse, and buy retail products - apparel, beauty, electronics, auto parts and more - across Wolt, DoorDash and Deliveroo. Retail is a large growth opportunity for the business, and our mission is to be the most trusted and magical way to shop the brands and local stores customers love. You'll play a key role in making that real on mobile - from product discovery through to shopping experience in the apps millions of people use every day.

You'll join an evolving area where we are replacing and improving parts of the existing consumer apps, owning specific retail journeys within large-scale B2C applications. This means working in a complex environment where multiple teams own different parts of the same app, and where strong technical judgment is needed to create consistency, quality and speed across teams.

This role is primarily iOS-focused, but combined iOS + Android experience is a strong plus.

 

What you'll be doing

  • Leading complex cross-team initiatives through design, implementation, launch, and operational ownership, partnering with product, design, and business stakeholders to deliver measurable impact.
  • Driving and implementing native iOS and Android initiatives within shared consumer-facing apps - where retail teams ship alongside teams owning other journeys in the same applications - balancing speed, quality, and long-term maintainability.
  • Working within and helping evolve our server-driven UI (SDUI) approach, going beyond UI implementation to design configurable, component-based views.
  • Anticipating future product and architectural needs while establishing engineering standards across architecture, testing, release processes, observability, and incident management - proactively addressing scalability, performance, and reliability.
  • Championing AI-enabled tooling and practices that help mobile engineers move faster, without lowering the bar on quality.
  • Communicating complex technical decisions to technical and non-technical stakeholders - with clear estimates, timelines, and trade-offs that support predictable delivery.
  • Mentoring engineers - including those transitioning into mobile - and upholding engineering culture and best practices across teams.

 

What we're looking for

  • Deep expertise in mobile development and particularly with the iOS ecosystem, including modern best practices, performance optimization, observability, modularity, SDK design, server-driven UI, CI/CD, and the navigating the AppStore processes.
  • Experience operating at Staff Engineer level or equivalent scope, having led cross-team / cross-org initiatives.
  • A track record working on large-scale, native consumer (B2C) applications, ideally at a company where app ownership is split across multiple teams by vertical or feature area.
  • A pragmatic, impact-oriented mindset with a bias for action and simple, effective solutions. Comfortable navigating ambiguity and driving clarity and execution in a fast-changing business environment.
  • Ability to influence and align stakeholders through clear communication and technical leadership.
  • Experience mentoring engineers and contributing to a culture of continuous learning.
  • Practical experience using AI as part of your engineering toolkit, with good instincts for validation, quality, and when not to take output at face value.
  • Being familiar with Android, along with iOS, is a plus.

 

Location

📍This role can be based in one of our tech hubs - Helsinki or Berlin

 

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

title: Product Owner (all genders)
description:
Deine Rolle bei uns

Digitalisierung ist kein Buzzword, sondern eine Haltung.

In deiner Rolle als Product Owner (all genders) gestaltest du digitale Produkte, Prozesse und Lösungen, die echten Nutzen schaffen – für Anwender:innen, Organisationen und anspruchsvolle Projekte.

Du verantwortest die Produktvision, übersetzt Anforderungen in umsetzbare Lösungen und bringst Fachbereiche, IT, Stakeholder:innen und externe Partner:innen an einen Tisch. Dabei denkst du nicht nur agil oder klassisch – sondern situativ das, was wirklich funktioniert.


Welche Aufgaben auf dich warten

Digitale Lösungen gestalten & weiterentwickeln

  • Du entwickelst Ideen und Zielbilder für digitale Produkte, Prozesse und Lösungen.
  • Du strukturierst und priorisierst Anforderungen und übersetzt sie gemeinsam mit den Beteiligten in umsetzbare Lösungen.
  • Du begleitest digitale Lösungen über verschiedene Phasen hinweg – von der Konzeption bis zur Einführung und Weiterentwicklung.
Projekte steuern & Umsetzung begleiten
  • Du planst und koordinierst IT- und Digitalisierungsprojekte und behältst Ziele, Termine, Qualität und Ressourcen im Blick.
  • Du schaffst Transparenz über Fortschritt, Abhängigkeiten und offene Entscheidungen.
  • Du sorgst gemeinsam mit den Projektbeteiligten dafür, dass aus Konzepten funktionierende Lösungen werden.
Anforderungs‑ & Stakeholder‑Management

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
What's it all about?

The balance of power in the energy industry needs to change. The intermittency of renewable supply and the constant demands of the grid mean that we still rely on less efficient, more expensive and unsustainable fossil fuels to keep the lights on. At Gridfuse, our mission is to shift this balance through technology. To shift the balance of inputs, so that renewables become the world's main source of electricity.  

At Gridfuse, we develop the software that controls real renewable energy assets and turns them into a coordinated Virtual Power Plant (VPP) that can respond intelligently to energy markets and grid conditions.


Your impact

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will build the systems that connects our platform to these assets and turn energy-market and grid requirements into real-world actions. Your code will influence when batteries charge or discharge, how renewable assets respond, and how reliably these assets can participate in the electricity system. 

You will own and evolve core parts of the Control services, working closely with other software engineers and our renewable-energy experts.


The role

  • Design and build distributed control systems that coordinate fleets of batteries, wind turbines and solar plants 
  • Translate complex energy-market and grid requirements into reliable software behaviour 
  • Build the services responsible for communicating with physical assets and processing their telemetry, status and capabilities 
  • Design systems that continue to behave predictably when devices fail, networks are unreliable, messages arrive late or assets become temporarily unavailable
  • Build highly observable and resilient services that operate continuously in production
  • Take your services from architecture and implementation through deployment, monitoring and operation 
  • Work closely with energy-market specialists to understand the problem and turn it into pragmatic technical solutions 
  • Make architectural and technical decisions that balance reliability, scalability, simplicity and delivery speed 
  • Mentor other engineers and raise the technical bar across the team 


What we need from you

  • You are a self-starter who enjoys working in a fast-paced startup environment
  • You have several years of professional software engineering experience building and operating production backend systems
  • You have experience designing and architecting distributed systems
  • You have a “you build it, you run it” mindset and are familiar with Linux, Docker and Kubernetes
  • You have strong backend experience with Go or another modern programming language (We primarily use Go, but prior Go experience is not required)
  • Experience with asynchronous / event-driven systems. Experience with NATS, Kafka, RabbitMQ or MQTT is a plus
  • Solid understanding of SQL and NoSQL databases; experience with InfluxDB or Timescale is a plus
  • You communicate clearly and confidently in English


What we offer

  • Competitive hardware including a standing desk, 4K curved screen, and MacBook Pro  
  • City center office location including home office option  
  • EGYM Wellpass membership support 
  • Educational budget for every employee 
  • Team events, summer & winter parties
  • Real startup culture by having an impact in a small, motivated team   


Sounds good to you?

Please submit your complete application including your salary expectations and earliest starting date.   

After submitting an application our team will review this and get back to you within a couple of business days.

description:

autarc is building the operating system for energy installers across Europe. As we scale, we want our Go-to-Market organization to operate with the same level of automation, data quality, and product thinking as our engineering organization.


In this Internship, you will work on the technical infrastructure behind our revenue engine.


You will work directly with our Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, Operations, and Product teams to identify bottlenecks, build internal tools, automate workflows, connect systems, and deploy AI where it creates measurable commercial impact.


Role description

What You’ll Do

Work on our GTM operating system

  • Build the systems powering our entire customer lifecycle – from first lead to closed customer and expansion.

  • Turn fragmented processes into scalable systems.


Automate the revenue engine

  • Identify repetitive or inefficient workflows across Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success and automate them.

  • Build automations for areas such as lead enrichment, routing, qualification, follow-ups, pipeline management, customer onboarding, and retention.

  • Connect our GTM stack and ensure information moves reliably between systems.


Integrate AI into real workflows

  • Move AI beyond prototypes.

  • Build AI-powered workflows that help us qualify and prioritize leads, analyze calls and customer interactions, identify opportunities and risks, generate insights, and automate operational work.

  • Experiment rapidly with new models and tools and turn successful experiments into reliable internal products.


Build, don’t just recommend

  • You will personally implement what you design.

  • Depending on the problem, that might mean writing Python or TypeScript, building an n8n workflow, connecting an API, querying a database, prototyping an internal application, or working with our engineers on a deeper integration.

  • You should be comfortable moving between commercial conversations and technical implementation.


Drive measurable commercial impact

  • Technology is a means, not the outcome.

  • Your work should ultimately help us generate more pipeline, increase conversion, shorten sales cycles, improve retention, or allow our GTM organization to scale without adding unnecessary complexity.

  • You will work closely with GTM leadership to identify the highest-leverage problems and own them from idea to measurable result.


Requirements

  • You are a builder. When you see a broken process, your instinct is to understand it and build something better.

  • You have strong technical skills and have worked in Python and/or TypeScript

  • You have hands-on experience building automations and integrations using tools such as n8n and APIs

  • You are comfortable working with databases, APIs, webhooks, and data pipelines

  • You are interested in Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and the systems behind how SAAS companies create revenue

  • Ideally you have worked on or build internal tools, AI agents, lead-scoring systems, enrichment pipelines, or automated outbound workflows.

  • You have worked in an early-stage or high-growth startup where speed and ownership mattered more than clearly defined responsibilities.


Was wir bieten

An internship with direct influence on how autarc scales its commercial organization.

The opportunity to build GTM infrastructure and directly collaborate with our founders and GTM leadership.

A strong engineering and product culture combined with an ambitious commercial organization.

A beautiful office in Berlin and a team that values working together in person.

MacBook and everything else you need to do your best work.

Most importantly: a role where your output can directly influence how quickly autarc grows


Unsere Werte

Why autarc?

autarc is building the AI operating system for energy installers.

Our platform helps installers manage the entire workflow around renewable energy projects – from lead and site assessment to technical planning, offers, documentation, installation, and ongoing operations.

We already serve more than 2,000 businesses and are expanding our platform across Europe.

As our Go-to-Market Engineer, you won’t inherit a finished system. You will help design the next generation of our commercial infrastructure.

You will work directly with leadership, have access to the entire GTM organization, and be able to ship solutions that are used by the team immediately.

No endless strategy decks. No six-month implementation projects.

Find the bottleneck. Build the solution. Measure whether it worked. Improve it.

title: Working Student (all genders) – Robust Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction for Dynamic Scene
description:
Abstract

Feed-forward 3D reconstruction models can recover scene geometry directly from images or videos without costly scene-specific optimization. By combining large-scale pre-training, multi-view reasoning, and strong geometric priors, these models provide an efficient alternative to traditional reconstruction pipelines such as Structure-from-Motion, NeRF, and optimization-based 3D Gaussian Splatting.

Despite recent progress, current models remain sensitive to challenging real-world conditions. Occlusions, moving objects, illumination changes, nighttime scenes, reflections, rain, fog, and snow can result in incomplete geometry, unreliable correspondences, and temporally inconsistent predictions. Improving robustness under such conditions is essential for autonomous driving and robotic perception.

As a working student, you will support the development of robust feed-forward reconstruction models for dynamic scenes. You will investigate methods for handling occlusion, changing illumination, and adverse weather, and explore how large reconstruction models can serve as general-purpose geometric backbones for downstream 3D scene understanding, particularly semantic occupancy prediction and 4D occupancy forecasting.


These tasks interest you

  • Develop and evaluate feed-forward 3D reconstruction models for dynamic scenes using monocular or multi-view image sequences.
  • Investigate reconstruction robustness under partial and long-term occlusions, moving objects, and incomplete observations.
  • Develop methods to improve geometric consistency under illumination changes, low-light conditions, shadows, and reflections.
  • Evaluate and improve model performance under adverse weather conditions such as rain, fog, snow, and reduced visibility.
  • Compare the developed methods with relevant baselines and document technical and experimental results.


That makes you stand out

  • You are currently pursuing a degree in computer science, artificial intelligence, robotics, electrical engineering, data science, or a related field.
  • You have excellent programming skills in Python as well as hands-on experience with PyTorch.
  • You have a good understanding of computer vision, deep learning, 3D geometry, or multi-view vision.
  • Experience with depth estimation, optical flow, point clouds, camera pose estimation, NeRF, 3D Gaussian Splatting, or 3D reconstruction is highly beneficial.
  • Your language skills enable you to perform your role in English (at least C1 level). Knowledge of German is desirable but not required.

  • Comprehensive understanding of space systems, concepts of operations, and remote systems operation.

  • 3+ years of experience as a space systems engineer working across engineering disciplines (Mechanical, Electrical, Software, Controls, Radio/Comms, etc) 
  • Experience developing or integrating RF and optical payloads. 
  • Experience participating in architecture and design of digital systems including ground station networks, data distribution and data processing systems, and spacecraft data handling systems 
  • Experience coordinating or leading diverse technical teams spanning multiple engineering disciplines and time zones 
  • Strong interpersonal skills for building relationships with clients and effectively communicating with other members of cross-functional teams

description:
Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travellers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers including Google Maps and Booking.com.

We are one of the fastest growing startups in travel, backed by leading venture capital investors including TQ Ventures, Lightrock, Creandum, and Northzone, and are headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Following our recent $80m Series C funding, we are ready to push beyond.

We are looking for our first dedicated Application Security Engineer to build our AppSec practice from the ground up. This is a greenfield opportunity with a real attack surface: public partner-facing APIs, payment flows, and active bug bounties. You will own secure development, define what gets reviewed, implement security gates, build the "paved road" for ~150 engineers, and see the impact of your work in production within weeks.

What you will do:

  • Lead threat modeling and secure design reviews for high-risk changes, partner integrations, and payment flows.

  • Implement, tune, and enforce security gates in GitLab CI/CD (SAST, SCA, secrets scanning, and DAST) while minimizing developer friction.

  • Act as the primary technical owner for triaging, reproducing, and prioritizing findings from bug bounties, partner pentests, and automated scanners.

  • Work hands-on with the DevOps team to implement GCP organizational policies, IAM least-privilege architectures, and Cloud Armor (WAF/rate limiting).

  • Establish a security-champions network across engineering squads and leverage automation/AI-assisted tooling to scale code reviews effectively.

Workplace:

We are a remote-first company with teams located around the Globe.

Also, the HQ office is in Berlin, where the team often meets.


Who you are:

  • You bring 5+ years in AppSec (or 3+ years plus a strong software engineering/web-pentesting background), with a track record of true ownership.

  • You read and write production code (Python, Go, TypeScript, Ruby, etc.) and deeply understand web frameworks, CI/CD, and Kubernetes.

  • You have deep knowledge of web and API security, specifically authentication/authorization models (OAuth2, JWT), rate limiting, tenant isolation, IDOR, and XSS.

  • You have strong cloud security fundamentals (GCP preferred), specifically regarding public exposure, secrets hygiene, and WAF rules.

  • You prioritize by real-world risk, propose trade-offs rather than demanding perfection, and communicate complex risks plainly to engineers and leadership.

  • Bonus Points: You have experience securing high-volume, multi-tenant B2B APIs and utilizing AI tooling to accelerate triage and review.

What you can expect:

  • You will join a fast-paced travel tech company with a flat organizational structure.

  • You will join an international team of talented and driven people with a clear mission. Expect your colleagues to inspire, support and challenge you every day!

Aufgaben

Was du machst

  • Prozesse aufnehmen. Du sprichst mit den Menschen, die einen Prozess täglich durchlaufen – bei uns oder beim Kunden. Du hältst fest, wie er heute wirklich läuft (nicht, wie er laut Handbuch laufen sollte), wo Zeit verloren geht und was am Ende besser sein soll.
  • Konzipieren. Du entscheidest, welcher Teil sich automatisieren lässt, wo KI echten Mehrwert bringt und wo eine einfache Regel genügt. Du schätzt Aufwand und Nutzen ab und legst dem Prozessowner eine Empfehlung vor – keine Optionsliste.
  • Umsetzen, hands-on. Du baust die Lösung selbst: KI-Agenten auf Basis von LLM-APIs, Automatisierungs-Workflows, Anbindung bestehender Systeme über REST-Schnittstellen und Webhooks, dazu die nötige Datenaufbereitung. Und ein Skript in Python oder JavaScript, wo Klicken nicht reicht.
  • Review und Übergabe. Du gehst mit dem Prozessowner durch, ob die Lösung im Alltag hält. Du prüfst nach, dokumentierst so, dass eine andere Person daran weiterarbeiten kann, und übergibst sauber.

Qualifikation

Was du mitbringen musst

  • Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch. Du führst Prozessgespräche mit Anwendern und Prozessownern, teils bei Kunden im Mittelstand. Das geht nicht auf Englisch. Verhandlungssicher heißt: du diskutierst frei, auch wenn es fachlich und sprachlich kompliziert wird.
  • Mindestens ein Tag pro Woche vor Ort in Neumarkt in der Oberpfalz. Prozessaufnahme funktioniert im Gespräch, nicht im Ticketsystem. Die übrige Zeit arbeitest du flexibel und remote.
  • Echte Begeisterung für KI und erste eigene Erfahrung damit. Kein Zertifikat, kein Studienschwerpunkt – aber du musst schon einmal selbst etwas mit KI gebaut haben. Ein Agent, ein LLM-Workflow, ein Chatbot auf eigenen Daten, ein Automatisierungsskript mit angebundenem Modell. Wir fragen im Gespräch danach, und zwar im Detail.

Dazu:

  • laufendes Studium – Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Technologie- oder Innovationsmanagement oder etwas Vergleichbares. Die Fachrichtung ist uns weniger wichtig als deine Arbeitsweise.
  • Du hast eine Sache schon einmal zu Ende gebaut – nicht nur angefangen.
  • Du kannst dich in einen fremden Prozess hineindenken und die richtigen Fragen stellen.
  • Du schreibst so, dass andere es verstehen.

Was wir gerne sehen, aber nicht erwarten

  • Praxis mit LangChain, LangGraph oder vergleichbaren Agenten-Frameworks
  • Erfahrung mit RAG, Vektordatenbanken oder Prompt Engineering über Spielerei hinaus
  • Grundlagen in Python, JavaScript/TypeScript und SQL
  • Arbeit mit KI-Coding-Tools wie Claude Code, GitHub Copilot oder Cursor

Ausdrücklich kein Muss: n8n. Wir arbeiten damit, aber diesen Teil deckt eine Kollegin bereits ab. Wenn du es kennst, gut – wenn nicht, lernst du es hier in wenigen Tagen.

Benefits

Was du bekommst

  • Echte Verantwortung für eigene Prozesse – vom ersten Gespräch bis zum Livegang. Keine Zuarbeit.
  • Anleitung durch unser Senior-Team, aber viel Freiraum in der Umsetzung.

About Apheris

At Apheris, we are building the future of how AI is applied in pharmaceutical R&D. We enable leading pharmaceutical teams to discover and develop drugs faster. We host the industry’s largest federated data networks for drug discovery AI, spanning co-folding, ADMET, and antibody developability. 

Across these networks, models are trained on proprietary industry datasets to achieve higher performance and broader applicability while keeping data control and IP protected. We deliver these superior models through drug discovery applications that enable teams to run them at scale, further customize them, and integrate them into existing R&D workflows. 

  • AI Structural Biology (AISB) Network: Pharmaceutical companies collaborate in the field of co-folding, structure-based binding affinity predictions and antibody design.
  • ADMET Network: Pharmaceutical and biotech companies collaborate to improve small-molecule property prediction and expand into further drug modalities.
  • Antibody Developability Network: Pharma partners collaborate to federate historical and purpose-built antibody developability data sets for secure ML training, without data leaving each partner’s environment.


About the role

As a Working Student in Finance, you’ll be an integral part of our Finance team, supporting core processes that keep our business running smoothly. You’ll gain hands-on experience in Accounts Payable and Receivable, Expense Management, and Financial Reporting while working closely with cross-functional teams in an international environment.


What you will do

Accounts Payable

  • Process and record incoming invoices with precision and proper documentation
  • Manage payment cycles, monitor due dates, and follow up on outstanding invoices
  • Reconcile accounts payable to ensure up-to-date financial records
Expense Reporting
  • Review and process employee expense reports
  • Ensure compliance with internal policies and accuracy of claims
Payroll
  • Support the monthly payroll cycle across our entities and EOR countries, working closely with our Finance Manager who owns the process end to end
  • Check trial payslips against our records and flag discrepancies
  • Help keep payroll documentation and personnel files audit-ready and in line with data protection requirements
Yearly Closing & Audit
  • Assist in audit preparation by compiling documentation necessary for answering auditor inquiries
  • Maintain the audit request list, track open items, and follow up internally to keep the audit on schedule
  • Support the preparation of supporting files and documentation for the audit data room
Operations
  • Monitor the shared finance inbox and route incoming requests and invoices to the right place
  • Assist with day-to-day finance operations or ad hoc requests
  • Support the documentation of finance processes in our internal wiki as we build out investor-ready controls
  • Bring your own ideas on where AI can make our processes faster, more accurate, or more transparent


What we expect from you

  • Enrolled in a master's university program in Business, Finance, Economics, or a related field, ideally with a focus on Controlling, Accounting or Treasury
  • First practical experience in Finance (e.g. internships or vocational training) is highly appreciated
  • Strong analytical mindset and a structured, solution-oriented approach to work
  • Comfortable taking initiative and working independently in a fast-paced, international environment
  • Solid skills in Microsoft Office, especially Excel
  • Curiosity and enthusiasm for working with AI tools. Prior experience is a plus, but a willingness to experiment matters more
  • Attention to detail, excellent organizational abilities, and clear communication style
  • Fluent in English and German


What we offer you

  • A dynamic role with steep learning opportunities and real impact
  • Remote-first working - work where you work best, whether from home or a co-working space near you 
  • Flexible working hours tailored to your study schedule
  • Monthly wellbeing budget
  • Regular team lunches and social events 
  • Quarterly All Hands meet-up at our Berlin HQ or a different European location 
  • A fun, diverse team of mission-driven individuals with a drive to see AI and ML used for good 
  • Plenty of room to grow personally and professionally and shape your own role 


Logistics

Our interview process is split into three phases:

  1. Initial Screening: If your application matches our requirements, we invite you to an initial video call to explore the fit. In this 30-45 minutes interview, you will get to know us and the role. The interviewer will be interested in your relevant experiences and skills, as well as answer any question on the company and the role itself that you may have.
  2. Deep Dive: In this phase, a domain expert from our team will assess your skills and knowledge required for the role by asking you about meaningful experiences or your solutions for specific scenarios in line with the role we are staffing.

title: Working Student, Data & Analytics (m/f/d)
description:
Mission

Support the Data & Analytics team in its day-to-day work, from pipelines to Data Apps and Reports to answering business questions.


Role Overview

As a Working Student in the Data & Analytics team, you will work alongside our analysts on what the week actually needs: a pipeline that has to keep running, a Data App a team is waiting for, a question someone needs answered. You will work in Knime every day, on things people across the company use. This is a role with real ownership: you get clearly scoped tasks and regular check-ins, and between them you work independently.


Responsibilities

  • Support the team day to day: take on the analysis, Report, or fix the week calls for, and see it through

  • Build and maintain data ingestion workflows, and keep scheduled pipelines running as our data sources change

  • Build Data Apps and Reports that teams across Knime use to answer their own questions

  • Research questions other teams bring us, and come back with an answer they can act on

  • Improve existing workflows, Data Apps, and Reports: performance, cleanup, and documentation

  • Own your tasks end to end: ask the scoping questions up front, execute independently, and hand over results clearly


Requirements

  • Enrolled at a university or Hochschule in Berlin, based in Berlin, with at least 12 months of study remaining

  • Available at least 16 hours a week, and on site in our Kreuzberg office two days a week

  • Working knowledge of Knime and data science fundamentals

  • Solid SQL and database basics

  • You research on your own: you find the sources, judge what is relevant, and come back with an answer instead of a list of links

  • You draft Data Apps and Reports with AI support, and can explain the result

  • A high degree of independence: you structure your own work and unblock yourself with documentation and research, and you know when to ask

  • Care and reliability when working on things other people depend on

  • Fluent in English


How to Stand out

  • A Knime L3 certification

  • Experience with schedules, spaces, and deployments in Knime

  • Python or JavaScript for small snippets and custom visualizations

  • German alongside English


Leveling

This position sits in the Data & Analytics team within Operations and reports to Iris Adä, VP Data & Analytics. It is a working student position of at least 16 hours per week alongside your studies, with two days a week in our Kreuzberg office.


What Success Looks Like

  • The team hands you a request and stops worrying about it

  • Workflows you have touched are faster, cleaner, and documented well enough for the next person

  • You arrive with the questions that sharpen a task before you start building

  • Ownership from day one: you work on the Data Apps and Reports Knime's own decisions run on, not a side project parked next to the real work

  • Depth in the product itself: daily hands-on work in Knime, which counts for more on a data CV than any certificate

  • A team that explains its reasoning: an onboarding buddy, analysts who show you how they got to an answer, and hours that fit your semester


What we offer

  • Meaningful, hands-on experience working on Data Apps, Reports, and workflows that support real business decisions

  • Daily experience with KNIME and the opportunity to deepen your practical data and analytics skills

  • Flexible working hours that can be coordinated with your university schedule

  • A collaborative, international working environment where your ideas and contributions are valued

  • A modern office in Berlin-Kreuzberg and close collaboration with the team on site

  • The opportunity to take ownership of your work from day one and develop your skills through real responsibility

description:
Mission

Drive KNIME’s global growth by attracting, hiring, and onboarding top talent through data-informed and tech-driven recruitment strategies.


Role Overview

As an HR Specialist - Recruiting & Onboarding at KNIME, you will own the end-to-end recruitment cycle and deliver an exceptional onboarding experience for new team members. Partnering closely with hiring managers, you will optimize candidate pipelines using modern HR tech, ATS platforms, and AI-driven tools. This role offers the opportunity to shape recruitment marketing, foster diversity, and continually refine our hiring workflows in a fast-paced software environment.


Responsibilities

  • Partner with hiring managers to assess talent needs and drive the full end-to-end recruitment cycle.

  • Screen resumes, conduct initial phone screens, and lead behavioral interviews to evaluate technical baseline and cultural alignment.

  • Coordinate and schedule interviews while building strong relationships with candidates, hiring managers, and external partners.

  • Drive a diverse and inclusive recruitment strategy, supporting recruitment marketing and job ad promotion across relevant channels.

  • Maintain clean ATS records, analyze candidate funnels, and prepare hiring reports to guide recruitment decisions.

  • Manage operational pre-boarding and onboarding processes to deliver a smooth integration for new joiners.

  • Test, evaluate, and roll out AI tools to streamline sourcing, screening, and HR processes.

  • Proven track record sourcing and hiring across both the US and German tech/software markets, with a solid understanding of the cultural and operational nuances of both regions. 

  • Hands-on experience with ATS tools (e.g., Personio or Ashby) and a high level of digital savviness.

  • Clear communication and active listening skills with a strong customer-centric focus on candidate and hiring manager experience.

  • Strong team player with an agile, pragmatic mindset and excellent organizational skills.

  • Practical interest in or active experience leveraging AI tools to optimize sourcing, candidate engagement, and onboarding. 

  • High standards of confidentiality and data integrity.

  • Fluency in both German and English.


What Success Looks Like

  • Establish strong, trust-based working relationships with hiring managers and maintain clean, transparent candidate pipelines across active requisitions.

  • Deliver an efficient end-to-end recruitment process that maintains high satisfaction rates for both candidates and hiring managers.

  • Streamline pre-boarding and onboarding workflows to ensure new KNIMErs receive high operational support and a smooth integration into the company.

  • Successfully pilot and integrate AI tools to enhance sourcing and hiring efficiency.


What we offer

  • Impact & Ownership: A high-impact role with autonomy in shaping KNIME's recruitment and onboarding processes within a fast-growing tech company.

  • Modern HR Stack: The opportunity to experiment with and roll out cutting-edge recruitment tools, including AI applications.

  • Flexible Working Environment: Hybrid working arrangements and flexible hours to support a balanced personal and professional life.

  • Growth & Development: A culture that encourages continuous learning, skill expansion, and professional development.

  • International & Inclusive Culture: A collaborative, multi-cultural team environment with a strong commitment to diversity and inclusion.

title: Business Development Manager Wasseraufbereitung (all genders)
description:
Für einen etablierten mittelständischen Anlagenbauer aus der Umwelt- und Verfahrenstechnik suchen wir aktuell eine:n Business Development Manager (all genders).

Das Unternehmen entwickelt und realisiert anspruchsvolle Anlagen zur Wasser- und Abwasserbehandlung und begleitet seine Kunden über die gesamte Wertschöpfungskette vom Konzept bis zur Inbetriebnahme.
Der Fokus dieser Position liegt auf dem Auf- und Ausbau eines gesetzlich getriebenen, europaweit wachsenden Marktsegments.

Aufgaben

  • Sie treiben den Auf- und Ausbau eines wachsenden europäischen Marktsegments für die 4. Reinigungsstufe zur Spurenstoffelimination (EU und Schweiz) voran und verantworten dabei den gesamten Weg von der Priorisierung relevanter Länder und Märkte bis zum Vertragsabschluss.
  • Sie sprechen Anlagenbetreiber, Kommunen sowie Planungs- und Ingenieurbüros gezielt an und begleiten diese entlang der Phasen öffentlicher Vergabeverfahren im Bereich der Wasseraufbereitung.
  • Sie kalkulieren und erstellen technische Angebote, führen Verhandlungen und begleiten Ausschreibungsprozesse.
  • Sie beraten Betreiber und Planungsbüros zu passgenauen Anlagenlösungen und arbeiten dabei partnerschaftlich zusammen.
  • Sie bilden die Schnittstelle zwischen Vertrieb und Projektabwicklung und bringen Impulse zur technischen und organisatorischen Weiterentwicklung des Produktbereichs ein.
  • Sie entwickeln länderspezifische Markterschließungsstrategien vor dem Hintergrund der aktuellen regulatorischen Entwicklungen.
  • Sie repräsentieren das Unternehmen auf Fachmessen und Branchenveranstaltungen.

Qualifikation

  • Sie verfügen über ein abgeschlossenes technisches Studium, z.B. im Bereich Umwelttechnik, Verfahrenstechnik, Chemieingenieurwesen oder vergleichbar.
  • Sie bringen bereits Erfahrung aus dem Umfeld der Trink- bzw. Abwasserbehandlung mit, etwa aus einem Ingenieur- oder Planungsbüro, aus dem Anlagenbau oder aus der Zulieferindustrie.
  • Sie kennen sich idealerweise mit öffentlichen Vergabeverfahren aus und haben idealerweise Erfahrung mit der VOB und den Leistungsphasen der HOAI.
  • Sie verbinden vertriebliches Geschick mit echtem technischem Interesse und bringen Fachwissen aktiv in Beratung und Marktentwicklung ein.
  • Sie kommunizieren verhandlungssicher auf Deutsch und gut auf Englisch für die Arbeit im europäischen Umfeld.
  • Sie überzeugen durch Kommunikationsstärke, Teamorientierung, unternehmerisches Denken und Eigeninitiative und möchten sich langfristig in einem kleinen, kulturbewussten Team verwurzeln.
  • Sie bringen Reisebereitschaft innerhalb Europas mit (etwa 25%).

Benefits

  • 60.000 - 80.000 EUR p.a.
  • Ein klar umrissenes, regulatorisch getriebenes Wachstumsfeld mit langfristiger Perspektive
  • Großer Gestaltungsspielraum in einem technisch anspruchsvollen Umfeld
  • Ein kleines, eng zusammenarbeitendes Team mit ausgeprägter Kultur- und Werteorientierung
  • Kurze Entscheidungswege und die Möglichkeit, den Produktbereich aktiv mitzugestalten

Connectima ist eine spezialisierte Personalberatung, Headhunter und Executive-Search-Partner für Verfahrenstechnik und Filtration. Wir begleiten Fach- und Führungskräfte auf ihrem nächsten Karriereschritt, im DACH-Raum und international, entlang der gesamten Bandbreite dieser Branchen: von Membranfiltration, Prozessfiltration und Wasseraufbereitung über mechanische, chemische und thermische Verfahrenstechnik bis hin zu verfahrenstechnischen Komponenten wie Pumpen, Armaturen, Ventilen und Wärmetauschern. Unser Netzwerk umfasst mehr als 40.000 Fach- und Führungskräfte aus Chemie, Pharma, Maschinenbau und Umwelttechnik. Als reine Branchenspezialisten kennen wir die Unternehmen, Technologien und Entscheidungswege im Detail und beraten Sie persönlich, vertraulich und mit echtem technischem Verständnis.

title: Senior Payload Integration Engineer - UGV Platforms  (m/f/d)
description:
Join Quantum-Systems and help bring autonomous ground systems into real-world operations. As Senior Payload Integration Engineer, you will own the payload integration across our UGV platforms: the electrical, electronic, and mechanical integration of a wide range of mission payloads into our own Mandrill UGV and partner vehicle platforms. Your goal is a payload-agnostic platform with scalable, reusable interfaces instead of one-off solutions, so we can adapt quickly to evolving mission needs without redesigning the vehicle for every new configuration. 

This is a senior individual contributor role with real ownership. You drive the integration architecture end to end, from interface definition through bring-up and commissioning to the point where the complete E/E system is proven to work on the vehicle. You will work at the intersection of vehicle hardware, autonomy and MOSAIC orchestration software, mechanical engineering, suppliers, and manufacturing. 


What is your Day to Day Mission:

Payload Integration Architecture and Ownership

  • Define and own the electrical, electronic, and mechanical integration concept for various payloads across our UGV platforms, ensuring scalable and reusable interfaces instead of one-off solutions. 

  • Design, specify, and validate payload interfaces: power supply, signal routing, communication interfaces, connectors, mounting concepts, cooling, grounding and shielding, and serviceability. 

  • Enable a payload-flexible vehicle platform that supports a wide range of customer-specific payloads (power profiles, environmental conditions, data interfaces) without major redesigns for every new configuration. 

  • Electrical, Electronic and mechanical Integration

  • Integrate payloads into the vehicle power, network, compute, and control architectures: schematics, harnessing, connectors, fusing, diagnostics, and interface documentation. 

  • Work with vehicle communication buses (CAN, automotive Ethernet) to bring payload data and control interfaces cleanly into the vehicle architecture. 

  • Own the health of the complete E/E system: systematic cross-domain troubleshooting across payload, harness, power, compute, and software. 

  • Drive payload mounting together with internal vehicle teams and external suppliers: brackets, packaging, accessibility, vibration robustness, environmental protection, maintainability, and manufacturability. 

Bring-up, Commissioning and Validation

  • Plan and execute payload bring-up and commissioning on vehicle prototypes and demonstrators: mechanical fitment, electrical integration, software provisioning (flashing, configuration, diagnostics), troubleshooting, and validation up to full system commissioning where the complete E/E system is proven to work. 

  • Define acceptance criteria, build and run system-level test setups, automate recurring integration and regression tests with scripts and test tooling, and support field testing. 

  • Translate integration findings into design improvements for vehicle and payload interfaces, and feed validated test workflows into our CI and test infrastructure together with the HW integration and SW Factory teams. 

  • Work directly with payload suppliers: clarify requirements, review technical documentation, align interface specifications, and drive issue resolution. 

Cross-Functional Collaboration and Documentation 

  • Create clear interface control documents, integration guides, test reports, lessons learned, and reusable standards for future payload integrations. 

  • Actively support build-ups, rework, payload installation, and vehicle-level commissioning in the workshop during prototype and customer-specific integration phases. 




What you bring to the team:

  • Engineering degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Mechanical Engineering, Robotics, vehicle systems, or a comparable technical field. 

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in field robotics, vehicle, or mechatronic system integration; you have brought complex E/E systems to life on real vehicles or machines. 

  • Strong E/E integration expertise: power distribution, signal interfaces, connectors, wiring harnesses, grounding, shielding, diagnostics, and vehicle-level troubleshooting. 

  • Hands-on experience with vehicle communication buses (CAN, ideally CAN-FD or automotive Ethernet), including reading and debugging bus traffic during integration. 

  • Solid mechanical integration understanding: mounting concepts, packaging, tolerances, vibration, environmental robustness, accessibility, and serviceability. 

  • Practical software skills for integration work: Linux, scripting (e.g. Python or Bash), software provisioning and configuration of embedded devices, and issue tracking tools. You are comfortable automating recurring integration tests. 

  • Experience defining and running validation setups from bench and rig level up to vehicle-level testing, with a quality-first mindset and the discipline to design reliable, repeatable test setups. 

  • Strong integration mindset: systematic in debugging, structured in documentation, and able to turn unclear payload requirements into practical engineering solutions. 

  • Hands-on mentality: comfortable working directly on vehicles, prototypes, harnesses, brackets, and payload installations in the workshop. 

  • Strong communication skills across engineering teams, suppliers, procurement, and program stakeholders. 

  • Fluent in German and English. 

  • High ownership, pragmatic, and thriving in a fast-paced environment. 

Your Benefits: 

  • Direct impact: See your contributions rapidly integrated from cutting-edge research into industrialized products, flying in the field within short development cycles. 

  • Culture & Environment: A dynamic, fast-paced, and collaborative startup environment with flat hierarchies, efficient collaboration, and a strong emphasis on continuous learning opportunities. 

  • Work-life Balance: We offer flexible work schedules, and 30 days of paid vacation each year to support your personal and professional life.

  • Health & Wellness: We support your physical well-being with a company-subsidized eGym Wellpass membership, giving you access to thousands of gyms and sports facilities.
